Wisconsin Public Radio: Republican bill would abolish Wisconsin Elections Commission [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=100224_3&amount=25]
Team: First, Opponents of voting rights gerrymandered Wisconsin. Then they lost critical elections for Governor and State Supreme Court. Then they tried to fire the nonpartisan Wisconsin Elections Commission Administrator. Now they want to abolish the commission and give it's power to themselves to run their partisan agenda.
The Elections Administrator -- who " has been the subject of conspiracy theories and threats from election skeptics who falsely claim she was part of a plan to rig the 2020 vote in Wisconsin " -- has refused to give in to lies about how elections are run in Wisconsin. So the vote suppressors in the Wisconsin legislature just introduced a bill that would abolish the Wisconsin Elections Commission entirely and grant more power over elections to the state's Republican-controlled Legislature.
These state legislators are clearly obsessed with protecting their own power and will seemingly stop at nothing to stay in control of the most gerrymandered state in the country. This bill raises huge concerns about how this critical state -- where the margin of victory in the last presidential election came down to less than a percentage point -- will conduct the 2024 election.

| | **For Immediate Release:** October 2, 2024

**Contact:** Griffin Reid, Communications Director, _**[greid@indiana.gop](mailto:greid@indiana.gop "greid@indiana.gop")**_

_**Statement on Mike Braun's Victory in Tonight's Debate**_ **INDIANAPOLIS, Ind. (October 2, 2024)** – Indiana Republican Party Chairman, Randy Head, issued the following statement on Senator Mike Braun's victory in tonight's gubernatorial debate.
---
_**Statement from Indiana GOP Chairman Randy Head:**_
---
"Tonight's debate showed that Mike Braun is the right leader for Hoosiers. While Mike Braun focused on the issues that matter the most to Hoosiers—education, inflation, and healthcare— Democrat Jennifer McCormick pushed fringe topics that don’t reflect the priorities of Indiana families.

Mike understands the concerns of everyday Hoosiers and has the experience to tackle them. He’s committed to lowering costs, improving schools, and addressing healthcare. It’s clear Mike Braun is the right choice to lead Indiana, and he’s the clear winner of this debate.”
---

name: Office of U.S. Senator Raphael Warnock
subject: NEWS: Resources for Georgians following Hurricane Helene
body:
|
---

**Dear Georgians,** I pray that you and your loved ones are all safe in the aftermath of Hurricane Helene's devastating landfall in our state. I join Georgians all over in mourning those we have lost during this awful storm, and I am immensely grateful for the first responders who have risked their lives to keep our communities safe.

My office is monitoring on-going recovery efforts and has been in frequent contact with Federal, state, and local officials to ensure our communities get the help they need. Along with my colleagues in the Georgia delegation, I successfully urged President Biden to approve a federal Emergency Declaration for all 159 counties in Georgia, giving our state access to much needed federal emergency resources and assistance to supplement state and local preparation and response efforts. I'm also pushing to deliver additional aid and relief to aid Georgians in need, through a federal Major Disaster declaration. At [my request](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.ossoff.senate.gov%2fwp-content%2fuploads%2f2024%2f09%2f24.09.30_Sen.-Ossoff-Georgia-Delegation-Letter-to-Biden.pdf&redir_log=467840313863773), the President has declared a number of counties eligible for individual and public assistance. You can view the current list of counties here: [https://www.fema.gov/disaster/4830/designated-areas](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.fema.gov%2fdisaster%2f4830%2fdesignated-areas&redir_log=620164849347350). **In the interim, I wanted to share some resources to help you and your communities stay safe and begin to recover during this difficult time. **

**First and foremost, if you require immediate emergency assistance, please dial 911. For non-damage related questions, you can call 211 for assistance.**

_For additional assistance, such as food, water, or shelter-related questions:_
* The Georgia Emergency Management and Homeland Security Agency (GEMA) has compiled a list of resources related to food, shelter, and donations here: [https://gema.georgia.gov/hurricane-helene](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fgema.georgia.gov%2fhurricane-helene&redir_log=342039667901290).
* You can contact your local Emergency Management Agency, which can be found here: [https://gema.georgia.gov/locations](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fgema.georgia.gov%2flocations&redir_log=161468982826243). If you cannot reach your local agency, you can contact the Georgia Emergency Management and Homeland Security Agency (GEMA) at 404-635-7200 or 1-800-TRYGEMA (1-800-879-4362).
* Georgians receiving Supplemental Nutrition Assistant Program (SNAP) benefits can report food lost by submitting Form 841 to the Georgia Division of Family & Children Services, either at a county office ([https://dfcs.georgia.gov/locations](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fdfcs.georgia.gov%2flocations&redir_log=344406136424243)) or electronically: [https://dfcs.georgia.gov/form/food-loss-replacement-form](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fdfcs.georgia.gov%2fform%2ffood-loss-replacement-form&redir_log=578491599337396). More information is available here: [https://dfcs.georgia.gov/snap-food-stamps/benefits-replacement-request](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fdfcs.georgia.gov%2fsnap-food-stamps%2fbenefits-replacement-request&redir_log=491241163946499).
* You can also contact your local American Red Cross Regional Office. The contact information for their Georgia offices is available at [https://www.redcross.org/local/georgia.html](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.redcross.org%2flocal%2fgeorgia.html&redir_log=38708908009304) or 1-800-RED-CROSS (1-800-733-2767) 24 hours a day.
* You can also find more information about locating a loved one through the American Red Cross here: [https://www.redcross.org/get-help/disaster-relief-and-recovery-services/contact-and-locate-loved-ones.html](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.redcross.org%2fget-help%2fdisaster-relief-and-recovery-services%2fcontact-and-locate-loved-ones.html&redir_log=92247918812744).

_For those recovering from hurricane-related damage:_
* You can report damages to your home, business, or other property here: [https://damage-assessment-gema-soc.hub.arcgis.com/](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fdamage-assessment-gema-soc.hub.arcgis.com%2f&redir_log=08163776623346).
* You can find resources and apply for disaster assistance here: [https://www.disasterassistance.gov/](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.disasterassistance.gov%2f&redir_log=872967721596249).
* You may also be eligible for low-interest disaster loans for homeowners and businesses from the Small Business Administration, which you can learn more about here: [https://www.sba.gov/funding-programs/disaster-assistance/hurricane-helene](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.sba.gov%2ffunding-programs%2fdisaster-assistance%2fhurricane-helene&redir_log=037017912704520).
* Ready.gov offers resources on what to do following a hurricane: [https://www.ready.gov/hurricanes](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.ready.gov%2fhurricanes&redir_log=114102126835230).
* The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau has tips for handling finances while recovering and rebuilding after disasters and emergencies here: [https://www.consumerfinance.gov/consumer-tools/disasters-and-emergencies/](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.consumerfinance.gov%2fconsumer-tools%2fdisasters-and-emergencies%2f&redir_log=393950486023517) (Spanish language resources here: [https://www.consumerfinance.gov/es/desastres-y-emergencias/](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.consumerfinance.gov%2fes%2fdesastres-y-emergencias%2f&redir_log=078718512829416)).

_The Federal government offers several resources for those with health care-related needs: _
* People on dialysis/with end stage renal disease (ERSD) can reach out to the ESRD Network 6 (Georgia) toll-free hotline at 1-800- 524-7139. You can find more information on the Kidney Community Emergency Response website here: [https://kcercoalition.com/](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fkcercoalition.com%2f&redir_log=06965886315183).
* People affected by the storm may be able to apply for health insurance in a special enrollment period: [https://www.cms.gov/newsroom/news-alert/cms-announces-resources-and-flexibilities-assist-public-health-emergency-states-florida-and-georgia](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.cms.gov%2fnewsroom%2fnews-alert%2fcms-announces-resources-and-flexibilities-assist-public-health-emergency-states-florida-and-georgia&redir_log=165888114681981).
* The Federal government also operates a 24/7 Disaster Distress Helpline for toll-free, multilingual, crisis support service for those experiencing emotional distress related to natural or human-caused disasters. You can call or text 1-800-985-5990 or learn more here: [https://www.samhsa.gov/find-help/disaster-distress-helpline](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.samhsa.gov%2ffind-help%2fdisaster-distress-helpline&redir_log=52764475037420).

_Farmers and growers can also access resources provided by the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA):_
* You can find your nearest service center here: [https://www.farmers.gov/working-with-us/service-center-locator](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.farmers.gov%2fworking-with-us%2fservice-center-locator&redir_log=947275759083440), as well as resources for hurricane recovery here: [https://www.farmers.gov/protection-recovery/hurricane](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.farmers.gov%2fprotection-recovery%2fhurricane&redir_log=155073234864382), or you can call the Farm Service Agency Georgia State Office at 706-546-2266.
* It is important that agricultural producers keep detailed records of damages and report them to their local USDA Service Center as soon as possible.

_Unfortunately, frauds and scams can be common following a disaster, but there are steps you can take to protect yourself:_
* As a reminder, federal agencies will never charge you for disaster assistance.
* If you believe you may have been the victim of a fraud or scam, you can contact the Georgia's Attorney General's Consumer Protection Division at 404-651-8600 or 1-800-869-1123 (toll-free in Georgia) or online at [https://consumer.georgia.gov/](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fconsumer.georgia.gov%2f&redir_log=488328896232203) and report it to the Federal Trade Commission at [https://reportfraud.ftc.gov](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2freportfraud.ftc.gov&redir_log=65902521458192).
* You can find more resources about disaster-related frauds and scams here: [https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/how-avoid-scams-after-weather-emergencies-and-natural-disasters](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fconsumer.ftc.gov%2farticles%2fhow-avoid-scams-after-weather-emergencies-and-natural-disasters&redir_log=706997197302686).

Finally, you can read more about the activities of the Department of Homeland Security and the Federal Emergency Management Agency at [https://www.fema.gov/hurricane-helene](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.fema.gov%2fhurricane-helene&redir_log=231767713567262) (Spanish: [https://www.fema.gov/es/helene](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.fema.gov%2fes%2fdisaster%2fcurrent%2fhurricane-helene&redir_log=036418114764405)) and across Federal agencies at [https://usa.gov/hurricane-helene](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fusa.gov%2fhurricane-helene&redir_log=390633047148227) (Spanish: [https://www.usa.gov/es/huracan-helene](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.usa.gov%2fes%2fhuracan-helene&redir_log=22394201563260)).

As your U.S. Senator, the safety of Georgians is my top priority. My office will continue to work to ensure that all Federal resources are leveraged to assist communities across Georgia as they become available. My staff are available to answer questions and help you find local resources for further assistance. Anyone seeking assistance from my office can call (770) 694-7828.

During a recent visit to Augusta, which was hit hard by the hurricane, I surveyed storm damage, delivered supplies and met with local leaders and community members to hear what they needed from Washington in this challenging moment. But even in our darkest hour, what I saw in Augusta--and what I know about people in every corner of our state--is that Georgians are resilient, love their community, and come together during tough times. **And know that I will keep walking with you as I continue to work for you.**

Keep the faith,

U.S. Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock

| This is official correspondence from the Office of Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock. If you have any questions, please contact our office [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.warnock.senate.gov%2fcontact%2fcontact-form%2f&redir_log=51402161759365).
If you need help with a federal agency, please click [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.warnock.senate.gov%2fcontact%2fcontact-form%2f%3fpath%3dhelp&redir_log=904232600857435).

PRIVACY POLICY: Your e-mail address will not be shared with anyone else or sold in any way.
TO UNSUBSCRIBE, PLEASE CLICK [HERE](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16996.17366724.7248866.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.warnock.senate.gov%2fcontact%2fnewsletter-signup%2funsubscribe%2f&redir_log=564209011866492).

name: Gov. Larry Hogan
subject: Why I’m running
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Hogan for Maryland, Inc
body:
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/hogan-bio-email-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241002_hoganbiov2_aaef_acs&amtposition=2>
Patriot,

You might be hearing a lot about me on the news and in tv ads—in fact you’re
probably hearing conflicting narratives being painted from both sides of the
aisle.

That’s why I wanted to take a minute to reach out and tell you the truth
about who I am and why I’m running for Senate.When you finish reading this
over, please consider chipping in a donation to my campaign today. Any amount
makes an important impact in this race.
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/hogan-bio-email-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241002_hoganbiov2_aaef_acs&amtposition=2>

I grew up in Prince George's County. Both of my folks were the products of
close-knit Irish-American families, whose grandparents had left the old country
with nothing more than the clothes on their backs and dreams of a better future
in America.

My dad taught me about the importance of integrity. Fifty years ago, my dad,
Maryland Congressman Larry Hogan Sr. made a tough decision. He became the first
Republican to come out for the impeachment of President Nixon. He put aside
party politics and his own personal considerations and stepped up to do the
right thing for Maryland and the nation.

<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/hogan-bio-email-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241002_hoganbiov2_aaef_acs&amtposition=2>
In the 80s, I decided to take a job working in real estate. After 3 years of
learning the real estate business in a large commercial brokerage, I opened my
own firm.

I started my small business in the basement of my townhouse with one
associate. The business grew from there.

As I continued to grow my small business, I saw firsthand all of the high
taxes and rules and regulations in Annapolis and Washington that made things
more complicated than they needed to be.

Then, I watched Governor O’Malley cripple the state with ridiculous taxes —
even to the point of taxing the rain.

I decided something had to be done. Maryland needed change. So I ran for
Governor.

I knew running for Governor as a Republican in Maryland would be a longshot.
But that didn’t bother me. I wasn’t focused on party politics. I was focused on
the problems and solutions that would unite everyone.

<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/hogan-bio-email-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241002_hoganbiov2_aaef_acs&amtposition=2>
Because of people like you, we pulled off the biggest upset in America by
ending one-party rule and becoming the second Republican Governor to be
reelected in the entire history of our state.

I got to work on day one. For eight years, we proved that the toxic politics
that divide our nation didn’t need to divide our state, and we got results!

I am a lifelong Marylander, small businessman, and proven leader who has
continually beaten the odds to bring bipartisan commonsense solutions to
Maryland.

Now, I am running for U.S. Senate because I am tired of politics as usual and
partisan politicians who put party over country.

It’s not in my nature to sit back and watch the dysfunction continue without
doing what I can to fix the mess in Washington and make progress on the biggest
issues facing Marylanders and Americans.

This is a tough fight, but I am no stranger to uphill battles.

I know I can’t do it without your support.

This campaign is more expensive than any race I’ve ever run. Everyone is
looking at my fundraising totals as a sign of my strength and momentum.That’s
why I’m reaching out to you. Will you take a minute to chip in $10, $25, $50,
or more?
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/hogan-bio-email-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241002_hoganbiov2_aaef_acs&amtposition=2>

I don't aspire to be a United States Senator. I don’t need a title and I
don’t need a job, but I’m more concerned than ever about the direction of the
country and I have become more convinced that I can make a difference by taking
the approach and style of leadership I had during my eight years as governor to
Washington.

With your help, we’re going to bring our case for strong, proven, effective,
and independent leadership directly to the people of Maryland—all across this
state.

Thank you,
Larry Hogan

A Personal Message from Governor Larry Hogan:

<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241002_hoganbiov2_aaef_acs&amtposition=2>
Hi, it’s Governor Larry Hogan.

When I launched my campaign for the U.S. Senate, I did so with a deep resolve
to maintain the leadership style and principles that guided me during my eight
years as governor.

Fifty years ago, my father, Maryland Congressman Larry Hogan Sr. made a tough
decision. He became the first Republican to come out for the impeachment of
President Nixon. He put aside party politics and his own personal
considerations and stepped up to do the right thing for Maryland and the nation.

Today, Washington is completely broken because that kind of leadership and
willingness to put country over party has become far too rare. But it’s not in
my nature to sit back and watch the dysfunction continue without doing what I
can to roll up my sleeves and get to work.

I’m under no illusion this will be an easy road. But I’m no stranger to
uphill battles, and I know I can’t do it without your support.

I don't aspire to be a United States senator. I don’t need a title and I
don’t need a job, but I’m more concerned than ever about the direction of the
country and I have become more convinced that I can make a difference by taking
the approach and style of leadership I had during my eight years as governor to
Washington.

It’s no surprise this mindset has made me a target of the Washington
partisans. Despite early polls showing a lead, I know I’m the underdog in this

So if you can chip in a donation of $25 or more, it will go a long way in

For eight years, we proved that the toxic politics that divide our nation
didn’t need to divide our state, and we got results! Let’s get back to work
again and send a message to Washington that will be heard loud and clear across
the country!
Will you join me today and help end the dysfunction in Washington?

body:
Folks, I just stepped off the debate stage at Norfolk State University, and I am *fired up* about this election. It’s crystal clear to me after this debate that my opponent is the wrong choice for Virginia.
My top priority is building an economy that will help Virginians thrive. We’re creating jobs, we’re lowering costs, and we’re making sure tax cuts are going to the middle class, not major corporations and the wealthiest 1%.
We’re fighting for the essential human rights that every American deserves — from reproductive freedom to voting rights to the right to get necessary medical care without going broke.
And we’re doing all of that together — not pushing people apart or tearing them down.
I hope I made you proud tonight, and if I did, I’m asking for your support so I can win this election and deliver Virginia for Democrats. Will you pitch in 10 bucks tonight?
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Thanks so much.
-Tim

| | Dear Friends, Hurricane Helene has caused incredible destruction over the past six days. Across the south, we are gradually discovering the full extent of devastation and loss of life, and the stories we have heard are heartbreaking. In Augusta, trash and debris are blocking and contaminating water filtration systems, leaving hundreds of thousands to conserve water. In Vidalia, the situation is equally dire, with reports indicating that no personal property was left untouched by the storm. Energy workers throughout Georgia are facing “treacherous conditions” while restoring power to residents. From Valdosta to Metro Atlanta, homes have been severely damaged by flooding, submerged cars floated in the street and fallen trees and “water inundat[ed] streets and houses.” **As with any fight, we know we cannot face this alone.** Along with our neighbors in North and South Carolina, we have joined forces with our friends at [**Organizing Resilience**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94147148/502668253/1775529570?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20241002_f_HurricaneHelene_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWUzNmJlNS0xZTgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8Iw9PHvx5E8jw--gHUjd6cn6cM8lmO_1OmgVviNhZGo=) to maximize our efforts in helping our communities rebuild. [**Will you chip in $25 or whatever you can afford to their Hurricane Helene Response Fund? All donations will be directed to nonprofits and mutual aid groups on the ground who are working around the clock to get aid where it’s needed most.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94147149/502668254/1775529570?amount=25&refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20241002_f_HurricaneHelene_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWUzNmJlNS0xZTgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8Iw9PHvx5E8jw--gHUjd6cn6cM8lmO_1OmgVviNhZGo=) Incredible grassroots leaders have been instrumental in sending organizers into the field to assess needs to ensure the safety and well-being of those hit the hardest. Their teams are working tirelessly to deliver essentials like generators, food, and cases of clean water. As recovery efforts continue, immediate needs include generators and battery-powered chargers to help families reconnect with their loved ones. Officials in Augusta have been distributing water across the area as water service is suspended city-wide. Communities and local organizations are mobilizing resources and organizing rapid response efforts to save lives and protect people, and we will need to push for significant federal assistance as the road to rebuilding will be long and uncertain. [**Can you help us reach those in need? Rush a donation right now to the Hurricane Helene Response Fund, hosted by our partners at Organizing Resilience.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94147150/502668255/1775529570?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20241002_f_HurricaneHelene_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWUzNmJlNS0xZTgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8Iw9PHvx5E8jw--gHUjd6cn6cM8lmO_1OmgVviNhZGo=) In times of crisis, we are reminded that there is strength in coming together. When we ensure the well-being of our neighbors, uplift their voices and push for equitable access, we affirm their humanity and reinforce our identity as a community. Your support is critical as we work to secure both immediate relief and long-term solutions to protect our people and our democracy. Thank you for helping our communities during this difficult time. Stacey Abrams

subject: Maximize Your Impact
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SENATE CONSERVATIVES FUND AND NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE
body:
The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. | | |
---
|
---
If you’re like most conservatives, you get endless emails and text messages from candidates asking for money. _But how do you know if they are actually conservative and not just pretending?_ _How do you know if they even have a chance of winning?_ _How do you know if costly fundraising commissions and processing fees will consume most of your contribution?_ These are all important questions that everyone must ask if they want to be effective with their political contributions. **The Senate Conservatives Fund is one of the best ways to make your contributions count.** We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. Every SCF-endorsed candidate must undergo a vetting process to help us determine whether they share our principles and values and, more importantly, will actually fight for them after the election. Every candidate must also run a professional campaign capable of winning. But creating a list of conservative candidates is just the beginning; we also give you an _**[_**effective way to fund their campaigns!**_](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=dda6074e99474654bef114cb5aa9c53e&_e=bpftaulToQrbbehWIg1UWOLCaR8yo-qFTufhEcykNdVc9XNHvM3b0RvnxKLzCmnGDoHVqdB32OxIkw657HPzzpCbi8AVl3F4_Ghd5Y5pK5zsdBsgPSrB4_RtDyJ_FpgDiJjR0N2yQW0Sd1HcmroFf-Hy-qlKcbyu3wfkIJcgK_BRsrM4cK4AzROkgPYghjHiT5gSUZ5Pt2AKBQyyFkyyiwrzVwrmXkWYTVqFQUHN1eE%3D)**_ The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. Once you move away from the candidate’s campaign — whether it be a party committee, joint-fundraising committee, PAC, or other organization — your contribution's effectiveness declines. The only way we will defeat Donald Trump is by coming together to organize in communities across the country. And we can’t do this without you. | | |
---

We have to contact a huge number of voters and make sure they have a plan to vote.** That’s why we’re counting on _every_ Kamala Harris and Tim Walz supporter to knock on doors or make calls in their own communities this week. If everyone reading this email signed up right now, we would reach our goals in no time. But the hard truth is that not everyone will sign up. * **TOP NEWS**

**" How two billionaire preachers remade Texas politics,"** Nww York Times Magazine's**Ava Kofman** -- "Last December, **Sid Miller** , the Texas commissioner of agriculture, posted a photo of himself brandishing a double-barrel shotgun on X and invited his followers to join him on a "RINO hunt." Miller had taken to stumping in the March primary election against incumbents he deemed to be Republicans in Name Only. Not long after that, he received a text message from one of his targets, a state representative named **Glenn Rogers**. "You are a bought and paid for, pathetic narcissist," it began. "If you had any honor, you would challenge me, or any of my Republican colleagues to a duel."

Rogers, a 68-year-old rancher and grandfather of five, represents a rural district west of Fort Worth. He was proud to serve in a Legislature that, as he told me recently, "couldn't be more conservative if it tried." Since entering office in 2021, he co-authored legislation that allowed Texans to carry handguns without a permit, supported the Heartbeat Act that grants citizens the right to sue abortion providers and voted to give the police the power to arrest suspected undocumented migrants in schools and hospitals. In a Statehouse packed with debate-me agitators, he was comparatively soft-spoken -- a former professor of veterinary medicine with an aversion to grandstanding. He was not in the habit of firing off salvos, as he had to Miller, that ended with "Kiss My Ass!"

But the viciousness of the primary season had been getting to him. Nearly a year before the March elections, ads began to appear in Rogers's district castigating him not simply as a RINO but as a closet liberal who supported gun control and Shariah law. (Rogers was especially peeved by an ad that photoshopped his signature white cowboy hat onto a headshot of **Joe Biden**.) Some of the attacks originated from his challenger's campaign, while others were sponsored by organizations with grassroots-sounding names, like Texans for Fiscal Responsibility, Texas Gun Rights and Texas Family Project. By the time voters headed to the polls, they could have been forgiven for thinking that Rogers had disappointed a suite of conservative groups.

In reality, Rogers had disappointed two men: **Tim Dunn** and **Farris Wilks** , billionaires who have made their fortunes in the oil industry. Over the past decade, the pair have built the most powerful political machine in Texas -- a network of think-tanks, media organizations, political-action committees and nonprofits that work in lock step to purge the Legislature of Republicans whose votes they can't rely on. Cycle after cycle, their relentless maneuvering has pushed the Statehouse so far to the right that consultants like to joke that Karl Rove couldn't win a local race these days. **Brandon Darby** , the editor of Breitbart Texas, is one of several conservatives who has compared Dunn and Wilks to Russian oligarchs. "They go into other communities and unseat people unwilling to do their bidding," he says. "You kiss the ring or you're out."

Like the Koch brothers, the Mercer family and other conservative billionaires, Dunn and Wilks want to slash regulations and taxes. Their endgame, however, is more radical: not just to limit the government but also to steer it toward Christian rule. "It's hard to think of other megafunders in the country as big on the theocratic end of the spectrum," says **Peter Montgomery** , who oversees the Right Wing Watch project at People for the American Way, a progressive advocacy group.

Texas, which has few limits on campaign spending, is home to a formidable army of donors. Lately Dunn has outspent them all. Since 2000, he and his wife have given more than $29 million to candidates and PACs in Texas. Wilks and his wife, who have donated to many of the same PACs as Dunn, have given $16 million. Last year, Dunn and his associated entities provided two thirds of the donations to the state Republican Party.

The duo's ambitions extend beyond Texas. They've poured millions into "dark money" groups, which do not have to disclose contributors; conservative-media juggernauts (Wilks provided $4.7 million in seed capital to The Daily Wire, which hosts "The Ben Shapiro Show"); and federal races. Dunn's $5 million gift to the Make America Great Again super PAC in December made him one of**Donald Trump 's **top supporters this election season, and he has quietly begun to invest in efforts to influence a possible second Trump administration, including several [linked to Project 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/99739c6a-c880-4c30-9b8e-150e2c2acec8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Rogers believes he provoked the ire of the Dunn and Wilks machine for two reasons. He refused to support a school-voucher bill that would funnel taxpayer dollars to private schools, and he voted to [impeach](https://substack.com/redirect/020f3de3-43f6-4ad4-a764-4b81306b4a59?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Attorney General **Ken Paxton** , one of the machine's most powerful allies. (Paxton, who did not respond to requests for comment, was impeached in part for misusing his office to help a friend under federal investigation.)

Since neither of these issues particularly excited voters, many attacks focused on distorting Rogers's record on immigration instead. When his wife joined a text group for the spouses of incumbents under siege (they called themselves the Badass Babes), she saw that her husband was not the only opponent of vouchers who had supposedly given Democrats "control of the Texas border." The mailers sent across the state were identical, with only the names and faces swapped out.

The onslaught worked. Rogers lost his seat by 27 percentage points, and more than two dozen Statehouse candidates backed by the two billionaires prevailed this spring. These challengers received considerable support from Dunn-and-Wilks-backed allies like Miller, the agricultural commissioner, as well as from G.O.P. heavyweights like Gov. **Greg Abbott**. "You cannot overstate the absolute earthquake that was the March 5 primary," says **Matt Mackowiak** , a political consultant and chairman of the Travis County G.O.P." Miller had taken to stumping in the March primary election against incumbents he deemed to be Republicans in Name Only. Not long after that, he received a text message from one of his targets, a state representative named Glenn Rogers. "You are a bought and paid for, pathetic narcissist," it began. "If you had any honor, you would challenge me, or any of my Republican colleagues to a duel." Rogers, a 68-year-old rancher and grandfather of five, represents a rural district west of Fort Worth. He was proud to serve in a Legislature that, as he told me recently, "couldn't be more conservative if it tried." Since entering office in 2021, he co-authored legislation that allowed Texans to carry handguns without a permit, supported the Heartbeat Act that grants citizens the right to sue abortion providers and voted to give the police the power to arrest suspected undocumented migrants in schools and hospitals. In a Statehouse packed with debate-me agitators, he was comparatively soft-spoken -- a former professor of veterinary medicine with an aversion to grandstanding. He was not in the habit of firing off salvos, as he had to Miller, that ended with "Kiss My Ass!" But the viciousness of the primary season had been getting to him. Nearly a year before the March elections, ads began to appear in Rogers's district castigating him not simply as a RINO but as a closet liberal who supported gun control and Shariah law. (Rogers was especially peeved by an ad that photoshopped his signature white cowboy hat onto a headshot of Joe Biden.) Some of the attacks originated from his challenger's campaign, while others were sponsored by organizations with grassroots-sounding names, like Texans for Fiscal Responsibility, Texas Gun Rights and Texas Family Project. By the time voters headed to the polls, they could have been forgiven for thinking that Rogers had disappointed a suite of conservative groups. In reality, Rogers had disappointed two men: Tim Dunn and Farris Wilks , billionaires who have made their fortunes in the oil industry. Over the past decade, the pair have built the most powerful political machine in Texas -- a network of think-tanks, media organizations, political-action committees and nonprofits that work in lock step to purge the Legislature of Republicans whose votes they can't rely on. Cycle after cycle, their relentless maneuvering has pushed the Statehouse so far to the right that consultants like to joke that Karl Rove couldn't win a local race these days. Brandon Darby , the editor of Breitbart Texas, is one of several conservatives who has compared Dunn and Wilks to Russian oligarchs. "They go into other communities and unseat people unwilling to do their bidding," he says. "You kiss the ring or you're out." Like the Koch brothers, the Mercer family and other conservative billionaires, Dunn and Wilks want to slash regulations and taxes. Their endgame, however, is more radical: not just to limit the government but also to steer it toward Christian rule. "It's hard to think of other megafunders in the country as big on the theocratic end of the spectrum," says Peter Montgomery , who oversees the Right Wing Watch project at People for the American Way, a progressive advocacy group. Texas, which has few limits on campaign spending, is home to a formidable army of donors. Lately Dunn has outspent them all. Since 2000, he and his wife have given more than $29 million to candidates and PACs in Texas. Wilks and his wife, who have donated to many of the same PACs as Dunn, have given $16 million. Last year, Dunn and his associated entities provided two thirds of the donations to the state Republican Party. The duo's ambitions extend beyond Texas. They've poured millions into "dark money" groups, which do not have to disclose contributors; conservative-media juggernauts (Wilks provided $4.7 million in seed capital to The Daily Wire, which hosts "The Ben Shapiro Show"); and federal races. Dunn's $5 million gift to the Make America Great Again super PAC in December made him one ofDonald Trump 's top supporters this election season, and he has quietly begun to invest in efforts to influence a possible second Trump administration, including several . Rogers believes he provoked the ire of the Dunn and Wilks machine for two reasons. He refused to support a school-voucher bill that would funnel taxpayer dollars to private schools, and he voted to Attorney General Ken Paxton , one of the machine's most powerful allies. (Paxton, who did not respond to requests for comment, was impeached in part for misusing his office to help a friend under federal investigation.) Since neither of these issues particularly excited voters, many attacks focused on distorting Rogers's record on immigration instead. When his wife joined a text group for the spouses of incumbents under siege (they called themselves the Badass Babes), she saw that her husband was not the only opponent of vouchers who had supposedly given Democrats "control of the Texas border." The mailers sent across the state were identical, with only the names and faces swapped out. The onslaught worked. Rogers lost his seat by 27 percentage points, and more than two dozen Statehouse candidates backed by the two billionaires prevailed this spring. These challengers received considerable support from Dunn-and-Wilks-backed allies like Miller, the agricultural commissioner, as well as from G.O.P. heavyweights like Gov. Greg Abbott. "You cannot overstate the absolute earthquake that was the March 5 primary," says Matt Mackowiak , a political consultant and chairman of the Travis County G.O.P." subject: Telling it like it is and leading with our values / Decir las cosas como son y liderar con nuestros valores
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Sharing our GOTV message on the stage and at the doors
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dr.%20Doshie%20Piper%20-%20San%20Antonio%20rally.jpg]
As our get-out-the-vote efforts ramp up, TOP Board Co-President Dr. Doshie Piper joined progressive powerhouses Congressman Greg Casar and Senator Bernie Sanders [https://www.tpr.org/news/2024-10-01/vermont-sen-bernie-sanders-and-u-s-rep-greg-casar-fire-up-democrats-for-the-harris-walz-ticket] on stage at the Paper Tiger in San Antonio, to fire up voters and make clear all that's at stake this general election.
WATCH VIDEO of Monday’s rally here. [https://www.youtube.com/live/WZbVD3poQzg]
As Dr. Piper said on stage, this election is all about community, justice, and progress. And just as it’s important we raise our voices and take action for what’s right, we must also use another vital tool in our organizing toolbox to help us win that change – our vote. We flex our collective power not only by demonstrating in the streets, but by casting our ballot. We’re not just about winning elections; we’re about building power and building a movement. A movement that truly prioritizes the needs of everyday working people. This is how we’re going to change Texas into a state that works for ALL of us – no matter our race, age, gender, who you love, or who you pray to.
Remember: Early voting starts October 21 and goes through November 1. Election Day is November 5. Tell your friends and family to VOTE.
SIGN THE PETITION: Showing solidarity with San Antonians fighting to stay in their homes
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20with%20Soap%20Factory%20tenants.jpg]
In September, San Antonio’s City Council voted to approve an MOU that would finance a downtown baseball stadium, giving the green light to demolish the Soap Factory Apartments, a complex of nearly 400 low-cost apartments.
Residents at the Soap Factory Apartments have been fighting back against their planned displacement, demanding a seat at the table in these conversations. They are calling for more truly affordable housing for families downtown, not less. Between higher rents and the cost of moving, at a minimum, they will need far more than the $2,500 currently being made available to some tenants who will be displaced.
San Antonio Independent School District (SAISD) owns a piece of land where developer Weston Urban wants to build the minor league AA baseball stadium, and Bexar County has to approve diverting tax money to pay for the construction of the stadium in October.
SIGN THIS PETITION if you’re a San Antonio resident, to tell SAISD and Bexar County Commissioners they need to drive a harder bargain that works for Soap Factory residents and ALL San Antonians! [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/support-the-residents-of-the-soap-factory-apartments-and-tell-saisd-and-bexar-county-that-we-need-more-affordable-housing-for-families-downtown-not-less?source=direct_link&referrer=group-texas-organizing-project-2]
A chance to meet Bexar County's new Chief Public Defender
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/New%20Bexar%20County%20Chief%20Public%20Defender%20TOP%20meeting.jpg]
TOP and community members passionate about reforming our local justice system gathered Sunday for a meet-and-greet with Bexar County's new Chief Public Defender Keri Mallon . Mallon was appointed by Bexar County Commissioners earlier this year.
The session was informative, as attendees had the opportunity to hear directly from Mallon on her vision for improving outcomes for Bexar County residents being served by the Public Defender's Office, as well TOP's efforts to reduce mass incarceration and ensure all residents are receiving the quality legal representation they are constitutionally deserving of.
No matter your age, race, or income, TOP believes every Texan should have fair treatment under the law, as well as fair access to justice.
For more information about TOP's Right2Justice organizing, contact Laquita Garcia at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
TOP Tip: We need you registered to vote before the Oct. 7 deadline. Get it done.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20Texas%20voter%20registration%20card.jpg]
You have less than a week to register to vote in this year's presidential election, if you’ve been putting it off. Don't wait until the last minute. With the stakes as high as they are this election, our communities can't afford to take any vote for granted. GET REGISTERED before the October 7 deadline, and tell your friends and family to do the same. [https://govotetexas.org/]
Español
Compartiendo nuestro mensaje de motivación para votar en el escenario y en las puertas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dr.%20Doshie%20Piper%20-%20San%20Antonio%20rally.jpg]
Con el incremento de nuestros esfuerzos para motivar a la gente a votar, la Copresidenta de la Junta de TOP, la Dra. Doshie Piper , se unió a las potencias progresistas: el Congresista Greg Casar y el Senador Bernie Sanders [http://www.tpr.org/news/2024-10-01/vermont-sen-bernie-sanders-and-u-s-rep-greg-casar-fire-up-democrats-for-the-harris-walz-ticket] , en el escenario del Paper Tiger en San Antonio, para motivar a los votantes y dejar claro todo lo que está en juego en estas elecciones generales.
MIRA EL VIDEO de la manifestación del lunes aquí. [https://www.tpr.org/news/2024-10-01/vermont-sen-bernie-sanders-and-u-s-rep-greg-casar-fire-up-democrats-for-the-harris-walz-ticket]
Como dijo el Dr. Piper en el escenario, estas elecciones se tratan de comunidad, justicia y progreso. Y así como es importante que alcemos nuestras voces y actuemos por lo que es correcto, también debemos usar otra herramienta vital en nuestra caja de herramientas de organización para ayudarnos a ganar ese cambio: nuestro voto. Mostremos nuestro poder colectivo no solo manifestándonos en las calles, sino también emitiendo nuestro voto.
No solo se trata de ganar elecciones; se trata de construir poder y construir un movimiento. Un movimiento que realmente priorice las necesidades de la gente trabajadora común. Así es como vamos a convertir a Texas en un estado que funcione para TODOS nosotros, sin importar nuestra raza, edad, género, a quién amas o a quién rezas.
Recuerde: la votación anticipada comienza el 21 de octubre y continúa hasta el 1 de noviembre. El día de las elecciones es el 5 de noviembre. Dígales a sus amigos y familiares que VOTEN.
FIRMA LA PETICIÓN: Muestra solidaridad con los habitantes de San Antonio que luchan por quedarse en sus hogares
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20with%20Soap%20Factory%20tenants.jpg]
En septiembre, el Ayuntamiento de San Antonio votó para aprobar un memorando de entendimiento que financiaría un estadio de béisbol en el centro de la ciudad, dando luz verde a la demolición de los apartamentos Soap Factory, un complejo de casi 400 apartamentos de bajo costo.
Los residentes de los apartamentos Soap Factory han estado luchando contra su desplazamiento planificado, exigiendo tener un lugar en la mesa de negociación en estas conversaciones. Están pidiendo más viviendas verdaderamente accesibles para las familias en el centro, no menos. Entre el aumento de las rentas y el costo de mudanza, como mínimo, necesitarán mucho más que los $2,500 que actualmente se están ofreciendo a algunos inquilinos que serán desplazados.
El Distrito Escolar Independiente de San Antonio (SAISD) posee un terreno donde el desarrollador Weston Urban quiere construir el estadio de béisbol de las ligas menores AA, y el condado de Bexar tiene que aprobar la desviación de dinero de los impuestos para pagar la construcción del estadio en octubre.
¡FIRMA ESTA PETICIÓN si eres residente de San Antonio, para decirle al SAISD y a los Comisionados del Condado de Bexar que necesitan negociar con más firmeza para apoyar a los residentes de Soap Factory y a TODOS los habitantes de San Antonio! [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/support-the-residents-of-the-soap-factory-apartments-and-tell-saisd-and-bexar-county-that-we-need-more-affordable-housing-for-families-downtown-not-less?source=direct_link&referrer=group-texas-organizing-project-2]
Una oportunidad para conocer al nuevo Jefa de la Defensoría Pública del Condado de Bexar
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/New%20Bexar%20County%20Chief%20Public%20Defender%20TOP%20meeting.jpg]
El domingo, TOP y miembros de la comunidad apasionados por la reforma de nuestro sistema de justicia local se reunieron para un encuentro con Keri Mallon, la nueva Jefa de la Defensoría Pública del Condado de Bexar. Mallon fue designada por los Comisionados del Condado de Bexar a principios de este año.
La sesión fue informativa, ya que los asistentes tuvieron la oportunidad de escuchar directamente a Mallon sobre su visión para mejorar los resultados para los residentes del Condado de Bexar atendidos por la Oficina de la Defensoría Pública, así como los esfuerzos de TOP para reducir el encarcelamiento masivo y asegurar que todos los residentes reciban la representación legal de calidad que merecen constitucionalmente.
Sin importar su edad, raza o ingresos, TOP cree que todos los texanos deben tener un trato justo ante la ley, así como un acceso justo a la justicia.
Para obtener más información sobre la campaña Right2Justice de TOP, comuníquese con Laquita García en lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
Consejos de TOP: Registrate para votar antes de la fecha límite del 7 de octubre. Hazlo.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20Texas%20voter%20registration%20card.jpg]
Te queda menos de una semana para registrarte y votar en las elecciones presidenciales de este año, si lo has estado posponiendo. No esperes hasta el último momento. Con lo mucho que está en juego en esta elección, nuestras comunidades no pueden darse el lujo de dar ningún voto por sentado. REGÍSTRATE antes de la fecha límite del 7 de octubre y dile a tus amigos y familiares que hagan lo mismo. [https://govotetexas.org/]

clean_body: Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español] Sharing our GOTV message on the stage and at the doors [] As our get-out-the-vote efforts ramp up, TOP Board Co-President Dr. Doshie Piper joined progressive powerhouses Congressman Greg Casar and Senator Bernie Sanders [] on stage at the Paper Tiger in San Antonio, to fire up voters and make clear all that's at stake this general election. WATCH VIDEO of Monday’s rally here. [] As Dr. Piper said on stage, this election is all about community, justice, and progress. And just as it’s important we raise our voices and take action for what’s right, we must also use another vital tool in our organizing toolbox to help us win that change – our vote. We flex our collective power not only by demonstrating in the streets, but by casting our ballot. We’re not just about winning elections; we’re about building power and building a movement. A movement that truly prioritizes the needs of everyday working people. This is how we’re going to change Texas into a state that works for ALL of us – no matter our race, age, gender, who you love, or who you pray to. Remember: Early voting starts October 21 and goes through November 1. Election Day is November 5. Tell your friends and family to VOTE. SIGN THE PETITION: Showing solidarity with San Antonians fighting to stay in their homes [] In September, San Antonio’s City Council voted to approve an MOU that would finance a downtown baseball stadium, giving the green light to demolish the Soap Factory Apartments, a complex of nearly 400 low-cost apartments. Residents at the Soap Factory Apartments have been fighting back against their planned displacement, demanding a seat at the table in these conversations. They are calling for more truly affordable housing for families downtown, not less. Between higher rents and the cost of moving, at a minimum, they will need far more than the $2,500 currently being made available to some tenants who will be displaced. San Antonio Independent School District (SAISD) owns a piece of land where developer Weston Urban wants to build the minor league AA baseball stadium, and Bexar County has to approve diverting tax money to pay for the construction of the stadium in October. SIGN THIS PETITION if you’re a San Antonio resident, to tell SAISD and Bexar County Commissioners they need to drive a harder bargain that works for Soap Factory residents and ALL San Antonians! [] A chance to meet Bexar County's new Chief Public Defender [] TOP and community members passionate about reforming our local justice system gathered Sunday for a meet-and-greet with Bexar County's new Chief Public Defender Keri Mallon . Mallon was appointed by Bexar County Commissioners earlier this year. The session was informative, as attendees had the opportunity to hear directly from Mallon on her vision for improving outcomes for Bexar County residents being served by the Public Defender's Office, as well TOP's efforts to reduce mass incarceration and ensure all residents are receiving the quality legal representation they are constitutionally deserving of. No matter your age, race, or income, TOP believes every Texan should have fair treatment under the law, as well as fair access to justice. For more information about TOP's Right2Justice organizing, contact Laquita Garcia at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] . TOP Tip: We need you registered to vote before the Oct. 7 deadline. Get it done. [] You have less than a week to register to vote in this year's presidential election, if you’ve been putting it off. Don't wait until the last minute. With the stakes as high as they are this election, our communities can't afford to take any vote for granted. GET REGISTERED before the October 7 deadline, and tell your friends and family to do the same. [] Español Compartiendo nuestro mensaje de motivación para votar en el escenario y en las puertas [] Con el incremento de nuestros esfuerzos para motivar a la gente a votar, la Copresidenta de la Junta de TOP, la Dra. Doshie Piper , se unió a las potencias progresistas: el Congresista Greg Casar y el Senador Bernie Sanders [] , en el escenario del Paper Tiger en San Antonio, para motivar a los votantes y dejar claro todo lo que está en juego en estas elecciones generales. MIRA EL VIDEO de la manifestación del lunes aquí. [] Como dijo el Dr. Piper en el escenario, estas elecciones se tratan de comunidad, justicia y progreso. Y así como es importante que alcemos nuestras voces y actuemos por lo que es correcto, también debemos usar otra herramienta vital en nuestra caja de herramientas de organización para ayudarnos a ganar ese cambio: nuestro voto. Mostremos nuestro poder colectivo no solo manifestándonos en las calles, sino también emitiendo nuestro voto. No solo se trata de ganar elecciones; se trata de construir poder y construir un movimiento. Un movimiento que realmente priorice las necesidades de la gente trabajadora común. Así es como vamos a convertir a Texas en un estado que funcione para TODOS nosotros, sin importar nuestra raza, edad, género, a quién amas o a quién rezas. Recuerde: la votación anticipada comienza el 21 de octubre y continúa hasta el 1 de noviembre. El día de las elecciones es el 5 de noviembre. Dígales a sus amigos y familiares que VOTEN. FIRMA LA PETICIÓN: Muestra solidaridad con los habitantes de San Antonio que luchan por quedarse en sus hogares [] En septiembre, el Ayuntamiento de San Antonio votó para aprobar un memorando de entendimiento que financiaría un estadio de béisbol en el centro de la ciudad, dando luz verde a la demolición de los apartamentos Soap Factory, un complejo de casi 400 apartamentos de bajo costo. Los residentes de los apartamentos Soap Factory han estado luchando contra su desplazamiento planificado, exigiendo tener un lugar en la mesa de negociación en estas conversaciones. Están pidiendo más viviendas verdaderamente accesibles para las familias en el centro, no menos. Entre el aumento de las rentas y el costo de mudanza, como mínimo, necesitarán mucho más que los $2,500 que actualmente se están ofreciendo a algunos inquilinos que serán desplazados. El Distrito Escolar Independiente de San Antonio (SAISD) posee un terreno donde el desarrollador Weston Urban quiere construir el estadio de béisbol de las ligas menores AA, y el condado de Bexar tiene que aprobar la desviación de dinero de los impuestos para pagar la construcción del estadio en octubre. ¡FIRMA ESTA PETICIÓN si eres residente de San Antonio, para decirle al SAISD y a los Comisionados del Condado de Bexar que necesitan negociar con más firmeza para apoyar a los residentes de Soap Factory y a TODOS los habitantes de San Antonio! [] Una oportunidad para conocer al nuevo Jefa de la Defensoría Pública del Condado de Bexar [] El domingo, TOP y miembros de la comunidad apasionados por la reforma de nuestro sistema de justicia local se reunieron para un encuentro con Keri Mallon, la nueva Jefa de la Defensoría Pública del Condado de Bexar. Mallon fue designada por los Comisionados del Condado de Bexar a principios de este año. La sesión fue informativa, ya que los asistentes tuvieron la oportunidad de escuchar directamente a Mallon sobre su visión para mejorar los resultados para los residentes del Condado de Bexar atendidos por la Oficina de la Defensoría Pública, así como los esfuerzos de TOP para reducir el encarcelamiento masivo y asegurar que todos los residentes reciban la representación legal de calidad que merecen constitucionalmente. Sin importar su edad, raza o ingresos, TOP cree que todos los texanos deben tener un trato justo ante la ley, así como un acceso justo a la justicia. Para obtener más información sobre la campaña Right2Justice de TOP, comuníquese con Laquita García en lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] . ---
Dear Friend,

I am reaching out to you today with a particularly urgent concern.

A staggering number of people worldwide have yet to hear God's Word. They live in locations where the Bible is either completely unavailable in their language or in severe shortage. The issue is more than a lack of physical Bibles; it affects lives and eternities.

We believe in the gospel's transformative power for bringing salvation, but how can it transform if people cannot read or hear it in their language? Some languages have yet to receive a single verse of scripture, leaving these communities in spiritual darkness.

At IMB, we've tasked ourselves with the enormous, yet urgent mission of providing Bibles and Scripture portions to these unreached groups.

That's why I'm emailing you now. I urgently need your support to provide MORE Bibles and put MORE missionaries in the field to teach the Word of God.

Your gift is much more than a book. It's the gift of life -- eternal life. It's each lost soul encountered by God's grace, a community transformed, a language lit by the Scripture's light for the first time.

**Will you provide someone with a Bible in their language today?**

Here's the link where you can give: [https://www.imb.org/generosity/gods-word-for-the-nations/](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0Mjc3LWVlNTI2YTBiYjkyNTQ2MDc5N2JjOWNhNmE0ZmJkYTY4IiwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMSIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmltYi5vcmcvZ2VuZXJvc2l0eS9nb2RzLXdvcmQtZm9yLXRoZS1uYXRpb25zLWNvbmZpcm1hdGlvbi8_dXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWdvZHN3b3JkbmF0aW9ucyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9djFfQUUtRkFMUjU1NjkzIn0/wAT5puCeJ48IQpR2d6jozA)

Thank you for your kind consideration. Your support can make a significant difference as we strive to bring God's Word to those who are yet to hear it.

Yours in Christ,

Angie Shepherd
Journeyman Alumni
Prayer and Missions Advocate

| Peter, Do you remember what you learned in school? Of course, most of us can’t remember exactly what we learned in grade school but our lessons on the basics of math, reading, and writing form a foundation for the rest of our lives. While I probably can’t remember a specific lesson, I still know how to write an email or balance my checkbook. I wish kids in our current New Jersey system were as lucky. Because, even though our schools are some of the best in the country, the focus of our educators has shifted from academics to wokeness. This is not an exaggeration–this is actually what children are learning in K-12 schools here in New Jersey:
* That [gender is a social construct](https://xtz223.keap-link020.com/v2/click/7354daaebd1bb36f193b227c5844949e/eJyNkMFuwjAQRP9lz9k6MakU5YYQQlEoh6o9V1GyAtNgW-sF6qL8e12oOLVSzzvzZmYvIGQ7K80ANXzIp9YzyICpN96QlYWz0vXXq34si1mRwWjs-4rd0UN9-dV8F1xdVVllINFTkrw8zxdts1m9rZtNm5S-45TxT06l75zl07xZwzT9CaaDkeUpsQPUwkf6XjSYtEpeeUz6nYgPtVI2ehfkoXcHpXOtVV6qIld2j1uyAzGaITGMRBwpBGcDenYnwlvvgGdiQjbbnaA4PDvmqFJ6532y_7yupXjrMH0B2iR4Jg==) and you can feel like a boy but be a girl “on the inside” and vice versa. Children are being taught this as young as the first grade!
* That white people [are inherently racist](https://xtz223.keap-link020.com/v2/click/3550c004064201fbc1a0b2d90a5509c4/eJyNkMFqwzAQRP9FZ2PZStIa30IIwTjNobRnIaQFL1EkIa3rusH_XjUtObXQ6-6b2Zm9MgKnHHWGteydPoRYsYJF0BgQHO28I6VvW7FZ16u6YBbd-RD9GFh7_VV8B26qZv1QMJoDZOTlebvru9NBHrtTn8mgYr7xT59G3H32T9vuyJblT2O4IO3fsndiLcURvhoZzK3oNdrMD0QhtZxP01RGUFZbyFHMqBWhd6X2F64iYR4nLiqx5pXg1SM3kAISSAMOlU1SR8yQsjIqDZIG8HGWmOSYwEjykkDpQc5-jFIPaE1uK-uqrsSmKQe62JxUhQDO_Ly5h_k77_IJqHmJkA==) and minorities are inherently oppressed.
* That men can have menstrual [periods](https://xtz223.keap-link020.com/v2/click/ba3376d32abcbbae17912a875dfc4d99/eJyNkEFLAzEQhf_LnDeGblcoeyullGVrD6JnCcnoRtdkmMxaY9n_bqzSk4Ln-d73eHMCwWCCdA5aeJePul5CBYzWk8cgmxjE2PO1vm4Wy0UFow8vO44TQXv6NXwBzqlV01QgmbAgd7frTd8ddg_77tAXkgyXjn96VvXFs71Zd3uY5z_F-Opl-1bcCVrhCb8WOV9WyT2PhR9EKLVaH4ecryI_acPi7YhJBzyqZ-SEWSU7xDgm9ciIipB9dIo4uslK0qXEEGFwPx_qMX9XzZ8QpXCb).

It's disturbing to say the least. Meanwhile, our children [are still not meeting as high of math standards](https://xtz223.keap-link020.com/v2/click/cc0093a45fc232747662cfd86146aeaf/eJyNkMFuwjAQRP_F5xgnTihpbgghFAU4VO25suJtY0hsy94QUpR_r6FVe6FSbyvtm5mdvRAELTSWkhTkjB-cpyQiDmplFWhcGY2ivm35PEvSJCKt0seNM70lxeWu-Ae4qfKMRwRHCwF5flquqnK_ed2W-yqQVriQ8U-f_NdnvVuWWzJNfxpDp3B9Ct6eFOh6uDaSKrTCF9cGvkG0vmBsGIaZNg6bAzgP46w2HfNo3Mg0DJ6B7GuBymjGY56xOGVJzsQbgqO1OSlJ9YEeacKpx15e08Kg2pa24p0qTTuBDVvwx4d4nqVxvGDhMmEtaPn91grGr_umT3gEf8M=) as they did pre-COVID. And [chronic absenteeism](https://xtz223.keap-link020.com/v2/click/879659e7338187d5dfdd7c50f9a11c54/eJyNkMFOwzAQRP_F57h2nKBGuVVVVUUpPSA4I2OviEtiW_amIVT5d0xBPYHEaQ_7ZmZnLwTBSouNJjV5xw8hCpKRAMp4Axa3zqJU1624K_Miz0hv7Ns-uNGT-vKr-AZcVVXJM4Kzh4Q8Pmy2bXPcPx-aY5tIL0PK-KdPJW4-u_tNcyDL8qcxDAZ35-QdSY1hhK9G2qRW-BT6xHeIPtaMTdO0si5gd4IQYV4pN7CILszMwhQZ6FFJNM4ywUXJeMV4zuyJRtU510cacdQphMqXmAaAiQONTgZjX6l3EalyZ6PZuqi4EKLkfM3ScdJ7sPrnsy3M3ycun1o_gkM=)–kids missing more than 10 percent of school days–is at an all-time high. The kids are not alright. And their number-one supporters–their parents–are being shut out of important decisions. Murphy’s dangerous [Policy 5756](https://xtz223.keap-link020.com/v2/click/36e198d91ce8cfb5e8edbfc97494ae28/eJyNkMFqwkAQht9lziGLiYWQm4iEEPVQ6rksu6NuG2eHzcQ0St69qxZPLfQ0h_n-72fmCoKkSWoLJXzJJctySCCgceyQZOlJtLlvs5f5LJ8l0Dr6rILvGcrrr-EncE8VeZGAjIwReXtdLJt6W72v620TSdYhdvzTU2RPz2qzqNcwTX-K8eRkdY7uDkoJPd4usi5eJbvQRv4owl2p1DAMKX2kB39WaHujxXlSnd6jjHGQZWVad9KCynrTqap3VpPBlO0-tmhmJPvzogbHR9f0DW40cI8=) actually instructs schools to hide a child’s “gender identity and expression” at school from parents. And while parental rights advocates have successfully stopped this practice in several districts, the upcoming school board elections may mean it will be reinstated. This is insanity! But, of course, it is the direct result of letting Leftwing lunatics run our schools for the past several decades. **As a mother myself, I can’t read about what’s being taught to children here in our state without getting very angry. But we can’t afford to be just angry anymore. We have to act.** And the main way we are acting here at the Common Sense Club is through speaking out. Will you join us? I encourage you to share this information with your network. Or consider sharing the post below on X.

## Troops Sent to Help Helene Recovery
The federal government is [deploying an additional](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fu7CAQAL8GurOWZQG5oHiNu3ttSgvDns0Jm5ON7CRfH13qdCONNNJ83Md7yCVv8_-wsm-POobY8smjgpu-IY0kk38wI2vJXjl0vSWjtFx8VAanPk026ahcmgwRahWigwBkAWX2CEgKQCsAZ6gj7nswyVoEJhOTIOCUW927Z81bW_hRvurJexfrKotfWnsdQv8TOAgcruvqpim-ncBh4-sQOIS95Vj4jXFe52_NZX1-Vrn79LpyKfmwThDMa8jlt9r-fjw9_gQAAP__KwtTCw) 1,000 active-duty soldiers to join the 6,000 National Guard members and 4,800 federal aid workers already engaged in relief efforts to help people affected by Hurricane Helene.The [Category 4 storm](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAQQL_m2ED2nbHD4KFShNQhXaqqI3LsI1zlQAQOUf6-art2fW95ep-n4RQky3x5C1f2ZVyGEIvsPGhVU41mMFXyIzMyVey1Q9dZ02qqJh_OMQXjXGCOI2NsnXU0djZRYh01VeJRodFKkVbKtaYx3HWqTdaiYtPGBEZxkrKszdcic5l4zM9l57WJy7XKfirltgG9APaAfTjHmR9bc1l-NGD_8Q7YZ9m5vt9SKLwB9tN9XSWGmeuJM88M1EsCOmpNHekDakDLc1mfr3_UGGXtoQW0G9BRHarVp9tDcpbNOjDqcg2Sf3PK_3N2j98BAAD__9x-YxY) caused catastrophic damage and flooding across six Southeastern states, killing over 180 people. Over 1 million homes are still without power.President Biden [surveyed storm damage](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuhSAUgOGngQ1zOB7kOjB0cbtdOxqU45UGwSjxxrdv2rn7n_z5vp7j08cU8-vTb-zqUkY_13jxqEG1CmkkGdzCjNxKdtqi7TsyupWrsxa4nyaawVpE7C0xPRajCYMJ3nQyOgQkDdBqAGuoIe57MKHrEJjMHAQBh1jL0XyXmOvKS7rLxUczl00mt9a6n6L9EDgIHJaYfZ65uf1aym8hcMj8PgUOUwycVeA9lVtpBQCqHqXsp9IGyDyshmatW5KHC_s7phTPzgqC1-Zj-pvV_-mXw58AAAD__2ygWPU) in South Carolina on Wednesday, a week after the storm hit, meeting with officials and planning visits to other states affected by Hurricane Helene, aiming to counter criticism of the administration's response.
## Footage Shows Sheriff Shooting Judge
Surveillance footage played at a preliminary hearing showed Kentucky Sheriff Mickey Stines repeatedly shooting District Judge Kevin Mullins in his chambers on Sept. 19, eliciting [emotional reactions from the courtroom](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO4yAUheGnwR0RXGOzFBTb0M22W0YOXJIbYxgBtuW3X2Xr6Y_0Hf1_v-5fCyXKzz_LhrbHcl98pwPvUvCRg7qrIdiICDgOaKUGbWY1yXF4WXiYeQaj42OcfymtNZhJx0eIo1qU12YgCwKUFGKUQuhJ3RQaI6YwzyBQTT4wJTBQL_X2LpT7C2O6yoH15ss2JPvq_bux8TcDx8Cd53nzZa-Elb_LXvOSPjsGrvVSLwYu49kYOF9pQwbugzNwUjBwQjJwK-a--_Xi7YWVYuQb-RUv3jplbPy9hyfyFQ_KfNtTotz4QQEL_7CdgdOTmoSSRgjNwA3Vhu-TUqI2a6bEc1vo_6Wh_xzysPAvAAD__2S4c8A).In court testimony Tuesday, it was revealed that Stines shot Mullins after seeing his [teenage daughter's number on the judge's phone](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOtCAURp8GOyaXK2osKP6Gbv52S8PCRZlBMYBOfPuNW2_55UtOTs7Xc3qaEMM2_zcrqerTZGwNJ00CeMtRTrJxyhMhtQ0pMeAw9rITbbOozhs5Ig0gLDrfWSGlHA0Aeen7dsQmKASUAqAVAEMnH5LGETrX9wgkO-uYBHKhpvx4pbDVhXy80kn5YdPaRLXUuhfW_mOoGert2lOp98VQ32CGWgBDDYKhPgrf6FMY6rIk-w7bzM_gKHFr9nrke78v_jrcTIWbGGkmx9cjO8r8--JloRy857uJPNMZ6EOOh43bdOTKUDdZuf0TYgylH5iEeTUh_mrWv6OdCn8CAAD__6-zbtQ).Stines allegedly told officers he acted due to a threat to his family, though investigators have not confirmed a motive.The judge and the sheriff had been longtime friends and co-workers, but police did not clarify the significance of the daughter's number. The case has shocked the residents of small-town Letcher County.
## List: Forbes 400 Richest Americans
The latest Forbes [400 wealthiest Americans](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGnwdtFcGBbHhi6eEvXjhYx53AVNhFc4-btq3bu_C-_vo_rcg2c-bi_h528bGUJq_CTFqPBArrFddFvREi2I29GHKfB9cZ2yeOG6xpiCIPRzrqhN73dxuk2UVxDtH3HHjU6o7U1Wo-9uziaJt3HYUBNrl-jcpoiS6mXz8KHJNryqzypXtayd9knkUdT9k3hrHCWRIlz_m0K51R2OuhsCueDvpuEuuwUOSwnV1I4u0lPaA2cqQA3kERwUsiSmJrAg2orB_ABr_JVoUkQgoNO2Eq9UQOnNWRuApUyhUZR4dxVHx8n58xtGJXT9z3w300n_7s9Pf4EAAD__5p3cYQ) list includes billionaires from nearly every state, with a combined record worth of $5.4 trillion. That total is up nearly $1 trillion from last year. The minimum net worth needed to make the 2024 list is $3.3 billion, up $400 million from last year.Tech giant Elon Musk topped the list for the third consecutive year with a net worth of $244 billion. Jeff Bezos, Mark Zuckerberg, Larry Ellison, and Warren Buffett rounded out the top five, representing Florida, California, and Nebraska. Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, Minnesota, Mississippi, New Mexico, North Dakota, South Dakota, Vermont, and West Virginia were the only states without a resident billionaire. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality.
We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. **I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate.**
**Making doughnuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. ****I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change._And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign in November._**

## Judge Blocks Texas Ban on Vote Harvesting
A federal judge ruled that Texas' prohibition on vote harvesting [violates the U.S. Constitution](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0jz1ztCAYAH-NdDg8yIcUFG9z3b1tSgfhQclxcqNEzL_P5Pr0u7OzH_fp7lJO2_LfPdHWK5bJ-ZpOnIDRgXIxCRLszIIBghY010ZqA0BWOyshdfBjRA6IsxlinEcNyvMZWFRIkuWMC2BsACYVl73QIzAcQQ1BeumhEwxDqmXv64oVL3fE_F1O3HtfniTbtdbX0Q3_On7r-K211m_Yjob4-AU6fns79IEbfbmrlo2epSJd3X7iUdO20M-vsCAFo9hogOw2vFrKOR1Kd4ItT5fyO1X_OD8t_wkAAP__7EFcKQ) because it lacks specificity and restricts free speech. The law was passed in 2021 by the state's Republican-controlled legislature after a months-long standoff with Democrats. After the law's passage, a number of left-leaning advocacy groups sued to block its implementation. The ruling by U.S. District Judge Xavier Rodriguez halts the state's [widely publicized investigation](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL-OtDAMxJ8mdEZJ-F-k-Bq6_dorkTcxkFOWrBIv7L79CaQrr7P9s0Yz83WbbuiD35b_-CDD7zlOaNnvNCkJFeh6qgtn7tINqiCjOt0NTTcoVazGSd3bWarWuoGUs3KweG-GznZW123vCm-01LWSslKyaXVT1l2vJPWqrVxjG6tELcl5jqnklZjemOfwiTul0sZHEczK_Myi-if0KPR4HEf5yhsd-cRCj-co9HinzJAZmc7tkhF6xMTehut0ugA5QCV_OVjcYIsQ4rZQAr_tlNkvyAQYAi3kwGKmDHGGPTLBiul62RaYyVHCAN8vtxBk_OQiGfc8fAg-t52o5fJAH64I_Eeju9E_AQAA__-kyXsY) into recent activities of the League of United Latin American Citizens. Attorney General Ken Paxton [vowed to appeal the decision](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHO4yAQhJ_G7tZiMRinoLjGXa690iKwdlAIRHhjJ29_SnRX_t0Un2ZG35_zfHYxxbz-dney_FrK7DzHnWYU0INUs2qDvYhwwpYsGmlO2pwQ26t1w4KjG01vjDYKPSJqVMMQxBKEFKGNVgqpUIgehR6k7pQZUdCIQx-01x4bJShELrXjKzG93Lakd9mpdr7c22SvzI-t6X81cmrkdBxH94Ucc6mZ3itlqi51a9kbOWU6tkZOlRK5jT7xPwf_QLhRhod7cclwxJTAl8wxPwkCLZRDzCt8B4ASeY4lQ8xMa438huQOcAtThfr8-IJLKv62tdWGx6csboNplFjvLqbvff7B5m7l3wAAAP__udZ8nA), saying it "risks undermining public trust in our political process."
## Cruz v. Allred Race Gets Tighter
The Cook Political Report has [shifted the U.S. Senate race in Texas](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LFuwyAQgOGngY3oOLCJB4Yu3tK1o3WBS4yKjWWfkvTtq2bv_Evf8H9dpguVWtb7Jy0c5XVrEyUpD54sGGfQT17neIU8WM3RBgxDFwZr9Rx9T6H3yPkKPQxoQ3ZEATkAORd40CUioLcAzkLXY3fy4WyBz7Z3uUtdssoD5yJtP8nMwi86bvWnPXg_pbboGmeR7VDuQ-GocJSZ51LrX1M4zm3hlZ-HwjHRslG5rwpHP1hwHswbMwevJGxSa99ma7VISVTNzlvbReGo95i3Z6m1HH1QHu4LlTev5Z8Tj4i_AQAA__-U2WAF) from "likely Republican" to "lean Republican," reflecting recent polling showing Republican incumbent Ted Cruz could be vulnerable to an upset from Democratic challenger Rep.
