name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 10/3/2024
body:
Adam Frisch, Jeff Hurd meet for likely their final 3rd District debate in Pueblo
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone,
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, October 3, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Adam Frisch, Jeff Hurd meet for likely their final 3rd District debate in Pueblo](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The last meeting between Colorado’s 3rd Congressional District candidates, Democrat Adam Frisch and Republican candidate Jeff Hurd, took place Monday, Sept. 30, at the Hoag Theater in Pueblo.
>From the beginning of the debate it was clear that moderator Earnest Luning was going to ask the candidates some difficult questions and he wanted specific answers. At some points during the debate, he asked follow up questions to get more specific answers for the public.
Luning, representing Colorado Politics, set the tone of the debate by asking both candidates how they were going to work with U.S. Rep. Lauren Bobert, who has represented the 3rd District and is now running in the 4th District in Northern Colorado and on the Eastern Plains, should she win in November.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Pro-abortion, ranked choice groups rake in big bucks for November elections](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Proposition 131, which introduces ranked-choice voting and open primaries, is the highest-funded initiative, raising $9.2 million, with major contributions from Netflix CEO Reed Hastings and philanthropist Kathryn Murdoch.
* Amendment 79, which aims to enshrine abortion rights in Colorado's constitution, has raised $8.1 million, with significant support from Michael Bloomberg and the Open Society Policy Center.
* Opposition to Proposition 127, banning the hunting of mountain lions, is led by Cats Aren't Trophies, raising $2.3 million, while its opponents, Colorado's Wildlife Deserves Better, have raised $1.4 million.
* Proposition 129, regarding veterinary care, is funded by groups like the ASPCA and Denver Dumb Friends League, while opposition, led by Keep Our Pets Safe, raised $1.9 million with backing from the American Veterinary Association.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Records: Venezuelan gangs terrorized each other before entering national spotlight](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Venezuelan gang members, particularly from the Tren de Aragua (TdA), have been involved in violent turf wars and criminal activities in Colorado, including home invasions, theft, and assaults.
* Two gang members, Carlos Aranguren-Mayora and Daniel Mora-Marquez, have been arrested for crimes ranging from burglary to illegal firearm discharge and domestic violence, with ongoing investigations and court hearings.
* These gang members have little personal background information available, making prosecution and tracking their criminal history challenging for law enforcement.
* Aurora Police and prosecutors are closely monitoring gang-related crimes involving Venezuelan immigrants, though the lack of records and immigrant crime history complicates the process.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘Just disgusting’: Coloradan describes flooded toilets, litter on Guanella Pass](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX31 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Heather Vigil, a fourth-generation Coloradan, describes worsening conditions on Guanella Pass, with severe traffic, overflowing toilets, and litter, making the area "disgusting" during the fall leaf season.
* Traffic on U.S. 285 has become unbearable, with illegal parking, road gridlock, and broken side mirrors adding to the chaos, making what used to be a relaxing autumn tradition stressful.
* Vigil suggests that timed-entry passes, similar to Rocky Mountain National Park, may become necessary to manage the overwhelming number of visitors, but worries it could limit access for locals.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘Harris is engaged in censorship on an industrial scale,’ Vance says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Sen. J.D. Vance criticized Vice President Kamala Harris and Gov. Tim Walz for promoting censorship, accusing them of trying to suppress free speech by silencing Americans’ voices on issues like COVID-19 and the 2020 election.
* Vance argued that Harris’ approach to handling "misinformation" and hate speech is a significant threat to democracy, more so than anything from recent years, citing her history of advocating for speech restrictions and pressuring social media companies.
* Vance highlighted the broader issue of government-led censorship efforts, such as using federal agencies like CISA to suppress dissenting voices, particularly on social media, while Harris has pushed for policies restricting religious freedoms and online speech long before becoming vice president.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Jack Smith lays out 2020 election case against Trump in newly unsealed filing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Special counsel Jack Smith detailed Trump’s efforts to overturn the 2020 election, focusing on disproving his fraud claims and challenging presidential immunity.
* The unsealed motion included new allegations, such as a Trump campaign employee attempting to incite chaos at a Michigan ballot center. Prosecutors claim Trump pressured state officials and spread false claims to challenge the election.
* Smith argues Trump’s actions were outside his presidential duties and should not be protected by immunity.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

_The new data on all the criminal noncitizens coming into the U.S. is shocking._
_U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement checks the background of illegal aliens it has in custody. But the ICE administration’s letter to Rep. Tony Gonzales, R-Texas, shows that as of July 21, ICE let 435,719 convicted criminals and 226,847 people with pending criminal charges back in their home countries into the U.S._
_Of those cleared by ICE, 13,099 have convictions for homicide, and 1,845 were facing criminal charges. Some 9,461 have convictions for sex offenses (not including assault or commercialized sex), and 2,659 face pending charges. The convictions include other crimes, such as assault (62,231), robbery (10,031), sexual assault (15,811), weapons offenses (13,423), and dangerous drugs (56,533)._

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: Help us understand CRT’s influence
body:
I’m reaching out because you’re an informed patriot who cares about this country.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7dhkt5bec2e393gemb88k3tnk7osqcd34mcsq48_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cjjm0pj6c1h2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zt32oa2bqar3ep8j5njcjehis9hlpj0qnijvboao_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cjjm0pj6c1h2bs)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zg8810e19hp4rivpvc51i7vr8507vk2bi1pqgkq8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cjjm0pj6c1h2bs)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Your participation and support are essential in our fight against CRT. Please complete the survey and consider a generous gift to help us continue our educational mission at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zar6rrr58i8qqrik8cfaphmh71b0mqfjf6vj1p0o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cjjm0pj6c1h2bs)

# [Crime is declining across the country -- tell Trump and Republicans to stop spreading the lie that it's "out of control"](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0933b8cd-c6f3-47dd-82e4-c4dbe0fd247e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Trump, J.D. Vance, and other Republicans out on the campaign trail love to stoke fear by proclaiming that crime is "out of control" in every city in America. At an event near Detroit, Trump said: "You can't walk across the street to get a loaf of bread. You get shot, you get mugged, you get raped." This is an out-and-out LIE. Actual data from the FBI show that crime is falling across the country. In cities and towns from coast to coast, violent crimes are on the decline. Trump and Republicans are trying to promote a culture of fear by spreading these lies. We can't let them. name: Dr. Michael Mann
subject: It’s not too late for us
body:
I’m not going to mince words: We are facing a planetary scale threat in the form of a second Trump term and a radicalized Republican Party dead-set on implementing Project 2025: The most extreme, anti-environmental and anti-climate policy agenda ever put forth in American history.
| | | | |

|

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tac9d1623-1944-4631-8458-9cf6514e226e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | | | Below is a personal message from Dr. Michael Mann – one of the world’s leading climate experts and the recipient of the Tyler Prize (often called the Nobel Prize for the Environment). [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Teaa0f494-78a7-4b21-9e96-a4f806348c79/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter – I have spent my entire career researching the Earth’s climate and the climate crisis facing our planet. **I’m not going to mince words:** We are facing a planetary scale threat in the form of a second Trump term and a radicalized Republican Party dead-set on implementing Project 2025: The most extreme, anti-environmental and anti-climate policy agenda ever put forth in American history. The fate of our planet and global climate action hinges on this election. But I don’t say that to scare you, I say that because it means there is still hope for us if we seize this moment and act. I want to explain more below, but before I do: [**Will you split a donation to my friends at 314 Action and Blue Amp Action?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T689d2def-1ef4-4298-99bc-bed09883c8cc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) They are working to reach hundreds of thousands of voters between now and Election Day and are working to elect the largest wave of Democratic scientists and climate experts to ever run for office. Donald Trump has shown us that he is more than just a climate denier. He and his Party want to exacerbate and accelerate the climate crisis by decimating the Environmental Protection Agency, reversing hundreds of policies and programs designed to drive down emissions and keep your communities safe from pollutants, and purging the Federal workforce of scientists and climate experts (he even wants to make it so you have to PAY to get weather reports!). On the other side of that debate stage, however, I saw hope. The hope is that we can build on the substantial progress we’ve made to reduce emissions over the past four years – including the largest climate bill and renewable energy investment in world history (and remember: it was Kamala Harris who cast the tie-breaking vote in the Senate to pass that!). I have no doubt that a Harris-Walz Administration will be the most pro-climate administration we’ve ever seen. But they can’t do this alone: They need pro-climate majorities in Congress and state legislatures all across the country if we’re going to make the necessary changes to stave off the worst-case scenarios on climate. It isn’t too late for us to change course (and I make the case for that in my new book ‘Our Fragile Moment’). But our window to act is closing and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans sweep to power in November and roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few years. If 314 Action-backed candidates win, we will secure pro-climate majorities in Congress and in state legislatures like Michigan, Arizona, and Pennsylvania. [**So will you join me in supporting them and Blue Amp Action by making a split donation before Election Day?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc9a2ee43-4807-46f8-ac1d-35c38559f05b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. Hi Peter,

Recently, the Center for American Women and Politics (CAWP) released a stunning report: the number of women running for Congress in 2024 is **_far less_** than it has been in previous election cycles (facts and figures below).

This trend is disturbing. We cannot lose ground on all the progress women have made over the past century. As we work to reverse this trend, we understand the urgency to elect the candidates who HAVE made the bold decision to run. We need to work harder than ever to ensure they win on Election Day.

[**Join our effort to reverse this trend by pitching in $20.24. →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94158501/502708094/-430846434?refcode=EM_F_241003cawp_N_CD_90DO_10_G_N_L1&amount=20.24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk3YjU0MzYyLTg3ODEtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Y_UVLPyF45-7SKOrYSKY5nmc5JcbV-XHACzBzcAfAtA=)

**Let’s look at the numbers:**

In 2020, 298 women ran for the U.S. House of Representatives. This year, **that number dropped to 256.** _Women only make up 23% of all candidates and nominees in election 2024_ , Republican women are an even smaller percentage of their party’s candidates – making up a mere 15.7% of House nominees.

Dangerous laws about women’s bodies are being crafted by rooms full of men across the country. We desperately need more women in those rooms.

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94158502/502708096/-430846434?refcode=EM_F_241003cawp_N_CD_90DO_10_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk3YjU0MzYyLTg3ODEtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Y_UVLPyF45-7SKOrYSKY5nmc5JcbV-XHACzBzcAfAtA=)

As the report points out, while the number of women running for office is down, _the forecast for female representation in the House and Senate will depend on what happens this November._

It’s not an exaggeration to say that the results of this election will make-or-break the future wellbeing of women in America. That’s why Her Bold Move is providing women candidates with the wide range of support they **need** to win their elections.

It’s harder to run for office as a woman. Women candidates are more likely to be subjected to sexual harassment, sexism, misogyny, double standards, and even death threats. But electing women to the rooms where decisions about our bodies are being made **__is as important as ever._ A little over a century ago, women couldn’t even vote, a little over half a century ago, women couldn’t open their own credit cards. We have truly come SO FAR – and we WILL NOT go back._**

This trend is disturbing. We cannot lose ground on all the progress women have made over the past century. As we work to reverse this trend, we understand the urgency to elect the candidates who HAVE made the bold decision to run. We need to work harder than ever to ensure they win on Election Day. = Let’s look at the numbers: In 2020, 298 women ran for the U.S. House of Representatives. This year, that number dropped to 256. Women only make up 23% of all candidates and nominees in election 2024 , Republican women are an even smaller percentage of their party’s candidates – making up a mere 15.7% of House nominees. Dangerous laws about women’s bodies are being crafted by rooms full of men across the country. We desperately need more women in those rooms. = As the report points out, while the number of women running for office is down, the forecast for female representation in the House and Senate will depend on what happens this November. That’s why Her Bold Move is providing women candidates with the wide range of support they need to win their elections. It’s harder to run for office as a woman. Women candidates are more likely to be subjected to sexual harassment, sexism, misogyny, double standards, and even death threats. You may have noticed the dog in the photos at the top of every email – that's Vince Neil (yes, named after the lead singer of Mötley Crüe). | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94168556/502741918/1012840921?refcode=em_fl_eha_20241003_fr_dogrs_cand_mf_30da_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNGJmNzk0MC04ZDgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1Fm6wMCf7P-Y4Zgk4vKY5s8uRCn8luQGWZPWTKiSOh4=)

Vince was my dog from 2011 to 2021, when he passed away from old age. And what bonded us most is we were both scrappy underdogs.
Vince Neil was rescued on the side of the road, likely after living in the woods for years. We called him a "retired cowboy" because of it. One veterinarian even found BBs embedded in his chest. What he'd all gone through before I adopted him, we never knew.
I grew up bouncing around Southeastern Pennsylvania, sometimes pouring water on my cereal because we didn't have money for milk. I joined the Army for stability and as a way to pay for college.
Vince and I both managed to find stability and a comfortable life as adults. **But in this race, I'm still the scrappy underdog.**
I'm up against a well-connected incumbent who rode his brother's coattails, takes money from corporate PACs (I don't), and rolls over for MAGA in the hopes it keeps him in power.

## Meeting w/President Trump

I have been _fortunate_ to speak at many different events and services but one event that I am **VERY excited** to be speaking at is the upcoming **Faith Leaders Gathering** w/**President Donald Trump** , **Dr. Ben Carson** , **Eric Trump** and other Pastors. This _HISTORIC_ **Faith Leaders Gathering** will take place in Charlotte, NC on Monday, October 21. This is NOT a fundraiser but a faith-raiser. If you are a pastor/faith leader and would like to be at this gathering then email me directly at **jackson@jacksonlahmeyer.com** If you believe your pastor would be interested in attending then please share my information with your pastor. The most important thing we can do right now leading up to the election is to **PRAY** for **President Trump** , the **Trump family** and our **nation**. [Pastors For Trump](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=15637638.8866.1.3cfd80a68fd1cf730340d9788d7ca708) will be hosting a National Prayer Call on Monday, October 7 at 7pm EST that anyone can join. name: PoliticsPA
subject: PA voters react to escalating Israel conflict
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

As tensions between Iran and Israel escalate, this segment delves into** the Israel-Hamas conflict's impact on Pennsylvanians**, approaching the one-year anniversary of the October 7th attacks on Israel.

Historian, **Dr. Daniel Pipes** , and Founder of PA 30 Day Fund, **Jeff Bartos** , shared insights you'll want to know.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **Historian and President of Middle East Forum,** **Dr. Daniel Pipes** , shares how and why "Hamas uniquely wants its civilian population to suffer." [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2f389d1f18&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Founder of PA 30 Day Fund and 2018 GOP LT****Governor Nominee, Jeff Bartos** explains how “Hamas has been in power since about 2006 and they have turned Gaza into a failed state."** **[[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=272fcc10db&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Public Opinion_
* Approximately **563,000 Democrats in PA support Israel's military actions** in Gaza, primarily concentrated in or around Pittsburgh and Philadelphia. [[L](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=ff57d0d74f&e=b7b3eddce2)[2Data](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4419ae3008&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Demographics_
* 44.6%,**a slight majority of PA's Jewish voters**, are registered Democrats, while 41.9% are registered Republicans. [[L2Data](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d52bb67f23&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Jewish voters** ** make up about 5.3% of overall registered voters in PA. [[L2Data](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b8ba2bc2d2&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* There are** ~23,000 registered Islamic voters **in PA, around 0.3% of registered voters overall. [[L2Data](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=53c38ef7e1&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Elections_
* Following Tuesday's VP debate, an instant poll of viewers **showed Vance narrowly edging out Walz**, 51% to 49%, in terms of performance. [[CNN](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1935a8b975&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Another snap poll found likely voters evenly split on who won the debate, though **Independents gave Walz a 57% to 42% advantage**. [[Politico/Focaldata](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7d0db11fb9&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|

| The Keystone Candidate Forum is a collaborative series hosted by _Voices of Reason_ , sponsored by the PA Chamber of Business & Industry.

Our goal: **everyone gets a fair shake in the Keystone Candidate Forum** with the belief that balanced dialogue provides every candidate an unfettered platform to share their views.

The forum spotlights competitive races across Pennsylvania, including statewide elections and key swing districts that could shift the balance of power in the state legislature.

Airing in October, the forum will stream online and be broadcast across the Philadelphia metropolitan area, with detailed recaps featured in the _Voices of Reason_ newsletter.
---
| _In Case You Missed It..._
_Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=79ea8056e4&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=331e089b13&e=b7b3eddce2). When we spoke recently, Trisha elucidated some of the problems in communities like hers.
“Farmers and ranchers are affected by climate change,” she said. “The cost of feed is higher than it needs to be. If someone is injured, there’s no hospital close by. And they can’t do telemedicine if they don’t have broadband. I want to fix all that and more.”
“What about the kids?” I said.
“Most kids leave after high school because they can’t earn enough locally,” Trisha said. “Kids shouldn’t have to choose whether to stay with family or leave for opportunity. I’m running to give them a ladder up so they can do both.”
Between Trisha Calvarese and Lauren Boebert, which one do you think cares more about her American neighbors wherever they live?

#

Hey Peter, born-and-raised Missourian John Goodman here.

| | **I am proudly pro-choice and believe that the right of every person to choose what to do with their own body is an essential human right.** In the wake of the _Dobbs_ ruling, I voted to pass two bills – the Women's Health Protection Act and the Ensuring Women's Right to Reproductive Freedom Act – to protect women's healthcare rights. Nevertheless, Congressional Republicans have made clear that if they retake a majority in Washington, they will move quickly to outlaw abortion nationwide. **A nationwide ban on abortion would override the protections here in New Jersey and would endanger the lives of countless women across this country.** Despite his attempts to distort the truth, the fact is that my opponent is running for Senate to support Donald Trump and the extremist Republican agenda, which would include banning reproductive freedoms across the country, leaving millions of women's lives in peril. In the Senate, I will not rest until we pass a clear, comprehensive law restoring reproductive freedom for everyone everywhere in this country. **We need an unapologetically pro-choice majority in Congress. We can't let a MAGA majority continue to gut reproductive care – and that's exactly what my opponent would do if elected.** [**We must win this race to hold the Democratic Senate majority and defend choice across the country. **With everything from abortion****rights and climate change to the future of our democracy at stake, I’ve been paying close attention to which states and which races are the most important – and everything I’m reading says that Nevada will be decisive for control of the White House _and_ the Senate.**
**[That’s why I’m personally reaching out to ask: Will you join me in supporting Sen. Jacky Rosen by donating $5 to her reelection campaign today? Every dollar will go a long way toward making sure she wins in Nevada so we can keep the Senate and the White House blue.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94182617/502778914/1399466761?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4989-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1M2Q3ZWNkZC05ODgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PwhDBrT6ikHDzmfdzYjQug1zFBq0Roe9ABSeAGVqrfo=)**

Look, I’ve witnessed my fair share of fictional, dysfunctional government. (I mean, have you seen _Veep_?) If we’re going to stop Trump’s GOP from making that kind of chaos and dysfunction real again, then we need to make sure Jacky Rosen wins in November so that we can defend our Senate majority. But the polls show her statistically tied with her Trump-obsessed MAGA opponent.

Just as the leaves change and the air grows crisp, so too do our lives transform under His care and guidance. Let this month be a time of reflection, gratitude, and renewed commitment to walking in His purpose. In preparation for Election Day, we are calling on you to join us in our National Day of Prayer and Fasting, for a powerful day of unified prayer. We will be live streaming to you a gathering of some of our favorite pastors to have an encounter with God. We hope that you will take some time out of your day to join us. I’m truly overwhelmed with gratitude every time I see the support pouring into this campaign. It reminds me why I’m in this fight, and it fills me with hope for what we can accomplish over the next month. And while I’d love to take a break from asking for help (trust me, I asked my campaign manager!), the reality is we can’t afford to slow down. We’re in the homestretch to Election Day, and this is when every bit of effort counts. Here’s the plan: We’ve set an ambitious $430,000 goal for our final GOTV (Get Out The Vote) push by October 31st. The month of October has a lot to look forward to: the changing of the leaves, pumpkin patches, Halloween, and some great events with Freedom Virginia!
October 17th: Cross-Generational Conversations with the Freedom Virginia Organizing Team
https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/669034/ [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/669034/]
After hosting our Youth Voter's Voices event we pondered the lack of spaces available for organizers, activists, and advocates of multiple different generations to come together to share their perspectives, knowledge, and experiences in a safe and accepting setting. We believe that both younger and older generations (and those of us in the middle) have a real desire to come together and be able to converse honestly to gain insight and support from each other. We are holding space in this event (and potentially future Cross-Generational Conversations) for people doing the work from a variety of ages and backgrounds to continue discussing important topics in community together. Join us as we work to break down the barriers between one another and delve into the deep conversations that need to be had for the benefit of all.

Register here! [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/669034/]
October 23rd: Young Voters’ Voices Round 2

Join young organizers from Freedom Virginia, The Latina Institute, The Arab American Anti-Discrimination Committee, Planned Parenthood Advocates of VA, and more for a panel discussion about what issues are top of mind for young voters heading into November, and how to effectively message on those issues.

clean_body: [] The month of October has a lot to look forward to: the changing of the leaves, pumpkin patches, Halloween, and some great events with Freedom Virginia! October 17th: Cross-Generational Conversations with the Freedom Virginia Organizing Team [] After hosting our Youth Voter's Voices event we pondered the lack of spaces available for organizers, activists, and advocates of multiple different generations to come together to share their perspectives, knowledge, and experiences in a safe and accepting setting. We believe that both younger and older generations (and those of us in the middle) have a real desire to come together and be able to converse honestly to gain insight and support from each other. We are holding space in this event (and potentially future Cross-Generational Conversations) for people doing the work from a variety of ages and backgrounds to continue discussing important topics in community together. Join us as we work to break down the barriers between one another and delve into the deep conversations that need to be had for the benefit of all. Register via Mobilize: Register here! [] October 23rd: Young Voters’ Voices Round 2 [] Join young organizers from Freedom Virginia, The Latina Institute, The Arab American Anti-Discrimination Committee, Planned Parenthood Advocates of VA, and more for a panel discussion about what issues are top of mind for young voters heading into November, and how to effectively message on those issues. Friend,
---
Ballots are in the mail. Votes are being cast. Exit poll data is rolling in.
---
The election isn’t next month. It’s happening RIGHT NOW.
---
But while the media releases its own exit poll voter data, I’m doing what I always do and going straight to voters like YOU to tell me where the people _truly_ stand.
---
[**Please take my 2024 Exit Poll Survey now that voting is already underway.**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6a7fb6e2ddd44a6f82a97b323c82c6f8&_e=SzOkd9UpPnABvdCPuvT3s58JUDwM4zH43C2Vs5hpChZgCk1VP4LhFBU20BHUrZHPzqCFNB29-cwmb0UyP2M7AjL_8LJyetb5M8QTb9NtdwtXRJoO_MkPBKk8Xr4w11SaqswQemZjG9cYRbhkciKZEvTHEUkASrI8crFsj9rZ8OY3x7x-J2qG5o_syeBFQmFVUJmScNSTgyFmzLFOMIved_r2KKegJNf539XjHIMi2Cj2wIKnTJZ6n_S5B2Cxlfwvd0R2dJsxN9Y4ENFMTY4ANahPOmjFJp4kFh7jPH_4fxBb_TSRcD1xuhHhd3nffGNvFyF-h5EZXjm7_IgELRTruOIzkuJ7-bqCkQqBcrYavk8%3D)

[TAKE THE SURVEY](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6a7fb6e2ddd44a6f82a97b323c82c6f8&_e=SzOkd9UpPnABvdCPuvT3s58JUDwM4zH43C2Vs5hpChZgCk1VP4LhFBU20BHUrZHPzqCFNB29-cwmb0UyP2M7AjL_8LJyetb5M8QTb9NtdwtXRJoO_MkPBKk8Xr4w11SaqswQemZjG9cYRbhkciKZEvTHEUkASrI8crFsj9rZ8OY3x7x-J2qG5o_syeBFQmFVUJmScNSTgyFmzLFOMIved7d59_ODWms1lGzpok1NwgUoCD9RspYuoviO1zLepaYZ2MXN0a5NoLdRjz8pDQIIl_SBYjSmZCd0rRuyubfWOqcnqq4qbhtfap2MbG9Cr2oKEA7P2HBJdNAs-LCN9GdruveE54rBjG-B6u1t3dBP7z0%3D)
---

If this election were decided solely by the issues, it would be a Reagan-level landslide.
---
Let’s be honest: **What could Kamala Harris possibly say to voters?**
---
_“Vote for me, and I’ll keep the border wide open, send 30,000 illegal aliens into your town, defund the police, empty jails, confiscate your guns so you can’t even defend yourself, raise your taxes, make it impossible to afford gas and groceries, and push us closer to World War III.”_
---
She wouldn’t get more than ten votes – and they’d all come from Washington, DC!
---
So, instead of running on the issues, she’s trying to **_BUY_** the White House and Congress for the high price of **$1 BILLION.**
---
_But I’m still committed to winning elections the old fashioned American way – by running on the key issues that matter to _YOU_ – the voters._
---
With voting already underway, I need you to take your Exit Poll Survey as soon as possible to ensure we’re running on the RIGHT issues – and let’s usher in a historic landslide victory.
---
[**Please take my 2024 Exit Poll Survey now that voting is already underway.**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6a7fb6e2ddd44a6f82a97b323c82c6f8&_e=SzOkd9UpPnABvdCPuvT3s58JUDwM4zH43C2Vs5hpChZgCk1VP4LhFBU20BHUrZHPzqCFNB29-cwmb0UyP2M7AjL_8LJyetb5M8QTb9NtdwtXRJoO_MkPBKk8Xr4w11SaqswQemZjG9cYRbhkciKZEvTHEUkASrI8crFsj9rZ8OY3x7x-J2qG5o_syeBFQmFVUJmScNSTgyFmzLFOMIved8NMgkDZxtcaR51DlfBhvZ_whK7yJLmAQNxJMZtTuGOJsKo1_zoGylp_SrltBaJ1KNe06jdhBAkNX-_6MPvVY007YJDI9XVgoOpi7aexmvHi79FrKCFG85UuNz3jh7aISVMBo1LnaM36X1uA7AFJ3qM%3D)

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkMGO2yAQhp8G32xhxjH2gUMkb6pKu9lKOfSICEyckTAgwFv17au0yQP0Ov_om2_-nx_6w5CnsJ7NhopK0bnoYPSdvC-tzbUte_5qfQyrFlwMbc9bDrpvnDqIfrpNDapeCjnLkXNo7mqQEsDNKJ1xzk0GuTSju8GEM8wHOzakHpyec-hHPvCpu-I8C3eFqxlwviGwge_JmYodhUIOi40xpeipki1dzGvj1b3WVBgcmTgxcaJwi91fY2c8duh2Jk4vd_z9WIJTsQwW3h-kOHMxiHd-XD6Xt7cLE-NeN13ini0yWFKOJaGtFNZntKGjfWOw4GbIP4fWbMnQGhgsNtfXoX9RDBVDZbC8f56_6R_H9vvl0r6-brJy6Rd5T2WUbODrA9rZuDX1f_r_UuJPAAAA__8tU49t)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkMGO2yAQhp8G32xhxjH2gUMkb6pKu9lKOfSICEyckTAgwFv17au0yQP0Ov_om2_-nx_6w5CnsJ7NhopK0bnoYPSdvC-tzbUte_5qfQyrFlwMbc9bDrpvnDqIfrpNDapeCjnLkXNo7mqQEsDNKJ1xzk0GuTSju8GEM8wHOzakHpyec-hHPvCpu-I8C3eFqxlwviGwge_JmYodhUIOi40xpeipki1dzGvj1b3WVBgcmTgxcaJwi91fY2c8duh2Jk4vd_z9WIJTsQwW3h-kOHMxiHd-XD6Xt7cLE-NeN13ini0yWFKOJaGtFNZntKGjfWOw4GbIP4fWbMnQGhgsNtfXoX9RDBVDZbC8f56_6R_H9vvl0r6-brJy6Rd5T2WUbODrA9rZuDX1f_r_UuJPAAAA__8tU49t)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Your participation and support are essential in our fight against CRT. Please complete the survey and consider a generous gift to help us continue our educational mission at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkMGO2yAQhp8G32xhxjH2gUMkb6pKu9lKOfSICEyckTAgwFv17au0yQP0Ov_om2_-nx_6w5CnsJ7NhopK0bnoYPSdvC-tzbUte_5qfQyrFlwMbc9bDrpvnDqIfrpNDapeCjnLkXNo7mqQEsDNKJ1xzk0GuTSju8GEM8wHOzakHpyec-hHPvCpu-I8C3eFqxlwviGwge_JmYodhUIOi40xpeipki1dzGvj1b3WVBgcmTgxcaJwi91fY2c8duh2Jk4vd_z9WIJTsQwW3h-kOHMxiHd-XD6Xt7cLE-NeN13ini0yWFKOJaGtFNZntKGjfWOw4GbIP4fWbMnQGhgsNtfXoX9RDBVDZbC8f56_6R_H9vvl0r6-brJy6Rd5T2WUbODrA9rZuDX1f_r_UuJPAAAA__8tU49t)

Please join me and Governor Ehrlich tonight in Walkersville!

We will be talking about how we can win this election... and what is at stake.

If you are anywhere near Frederick County, please join us from 6:30-8pm. If we haven't met yet, I would love that. If cost is an issue, please email us to work something out - we would love to see you there.

April will be baking some of her famous pies, but we'll have lots of pie for everyone. Have you tried April's pies?

The next month will be hectic, but good. If you can join me tonight, Thursday night, please do. It will be worth the drive, and I'd love to talk with you.

For our Country,
Neil

I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat-grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer. Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive. I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand. The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded. And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do. If we’re going to make our vision a reality, we have to do everything we can to make sure Kamala and Democrats in tough races across the country win on November 5th. Here’s what Pramila said about the work we’re doing on that front: “We’ve made 120,000 calls just this cycle for our endorsed candidates, and in swing states. We’re doing twice-weekly phone banks with the Harris-Walz campaign.” “That is also a very intentional way of making sure that I’m using my campaign and my platform not only to reelect me, but to make sure that we are helping toflip the House , to keep the White House , and to keep the Senate.” With just over one month to go until Election Day, we’re working hard to ensure Democrats win so that we can be in a position to act on our shared progressive agenda. But we need this grassroots team to help us do it! In solidarity, Team Jayapal | | Email us: info@pramilaforcongress.com

body:
I’m an OB-GYN. I’m also a state representative here in Ohio.
|
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94195026/502810285/-1500356530?refcode=ODP_ATA_EM_FR_somani_241003_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOGQzN2NhNi1hODgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3svTr2OXL2PisAc70ZcI1MCMLnDLRwE_n76REqupfjk=) Team,

**I’m an OB-GYN. I’m also a state representative here in Ohio.** I know firsthand how incredibly important it is that patients have the right to make their own health care choices. So in a moment, I’m going to ask you to [_**chip in to flip the Ohio Supreme Court**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94195027/502810286/-1500356530?refcode=ODP_ATA_EM_FR_somani_241003_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOGQzN2NhNi1hODgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3svTr2OXL2PisAc70ZcI1MCMLnDLRwE_n76REqupfjk=) – but first I want to tell you a little more about why doing so is so critical for reproductive freedom.

Last year – in the wake of the Supreme Court’s dismantling of federal protections for abortion in _Dobbs_ – Ohio Democrats fought to pass Issue One in order to protect reproductive rights in the Ohio Constitution and prevent laws like the GOP’s extremist anti-abortion ban from taking effect.

**We won.** Because of that win, abortion _should_ be accessible in Ohio. **But that’s not actually the case.**

Ohio Republicans refused to accept that Ohioans overwhelmingly defeated their efforts to ban our reproductive healthcare, so they’ve been dragging out Issue 1 in the Republican-controlled Ohio Supreme Court every day since then.

**If we fail to flip the court in November, we’re at risk of living under an extremist abortion ban here in Ohio again despite having it enshrined in the Constitution. As a physician I have experienced those consequences when trying to care for patients who need abortions.**

When the first GOP ban was in effect, physicians and patients weren’t sure what options they had. This led to a lot of confusion, and to patients being sent out of state for care – including a ten year old who needed abortion care. There were women in hospitals facing life-threatening situations, and doctors like myself and my colleagues were faced with the prospect of losing their patient or their license.

Data shows that states where abortion is banned or restricted have higher maternal mortality and infant death rates than ones where health care isn’t restricted by politicians.

**We need to flip the Ohio Supreme Court to protect reproductive health care.** I’m working every day to care for Ohio women and families. And the best prescription I can write is for us to elect Justice Michael Donnelly, Justice Melody Stewart, and Judge Lisa Forbes – the candidates who will support the Constitutional amendment which puts reproductive decisions back in the hands of physicians and patients, without interference from the government or politicians with no medical experience or background.

But time is running out before Election Day, and it’s all hands on deck. So I’m asking, right now: [_**Will you pitch in $5 to help support the fight for reproductive healthcare and elect a pro-choice majority to the Ohio Supreme Court that will stand up for our healthcare access and our fundamental rights?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94195028/502810287/-1500356530?amount=5&refcode=ODP_ATA_EM_FR_somani_241003_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOGQzN2NhNi1hODgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3svTr2OXL2PisAc70ZcI1MCMLnDLRwE_n76REqupfjk=)

Thank you for standing up with me in this important fight.

Dr. Anita Somani
OB-GYN

| Dear Fellow Patriot,

My name is Dr. Ben Carson, and along with my wife, Candy, I have spent years contemplating the challenges facing American families today.

Our new book, _The Perilous Fight_ , addresses these issues head-on, offering practical insights and solutions to restore and strengthen the family unit.

| Janet R. Fogarty Elected to RNC Executive Committee, Representing Northeastern Region
---
---
| Boston, MA- The Massachusetts Republican Party proudly announces that Janet R. Fogarty has been elected to serve on the Republican National Committee (RNC) Executive Committee, representing the Northeastern Region. This region encompasses the six New England states, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, Delaware, Washington D.C., Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands.
As part of her new role, Fogarty will join other members of the RNC Executive Committee in advising RNC leadership, including Chair Michael Whatley and Co-Chair Lara Trump, on executive and administrative matters that arise between full committee meetings. This committee plays a critical role in shaping the strategic direction of the Republican Party, ensuring that decisions are made efficiently while maintaining the involvement of key regional representatives.
The RNC Executive Committee is comprised of regional vice chairmen, including Fogarty, alongside the chairmen of the Rules, Resolutions, Budget, and State Party Chairmen Advisory Committees, as well as two appointees selected by the Chairman. This prestigious group ensures a collaborative approach to Republican governance, setting the agenda for the party's future.
In addition to her role on the Executive Committee, Fogarty serves on the RNC Resolutions Committee, the Grassroots Subcommittee, and the Convention Committee on Arrangements, highlighting her deep commitment to advancing the party's goals at every level.
"I am honored to represent the Northeastern Region on the RNC Executive Committee and to work alongside our dedicated leadership team," said Fogarty. "Together, we will continue to build a stronger, more vibrant Republican Party that champions the values of freedom, opportunity, and prosperity for all Americans."

###

The Left and the Industrial Media Complex already beat me once – and now all signs are pointing towards this race being a toss-up, despite what the Media tells us.

**_The Mainstream Media wants you to think I can’t win this race, but it’s just another one of their convenient lies to stop our movement._**

The only way I have a chance of defeating Klobuchar is with your support. I need to get my unfiltered and uncensored message to undecided voters here in Minnesota. They need to hear from me directly.

**The Radical Left is terrified of me – a free-thinking Black Republican who refuses to be a slave to their politics. They will do anything to stop my movement.**

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

Historically Black colleges and universities (HBCUs) serve some of our nation’s brightest minds, graduating 25 percent of African Americans with degrees in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math (STEM).

These graduates are the next generation of tech entrepreneurs and visionaries who will take the digital economy to new heights. Yet American companies are still unrepresentative of Black talent. And the average endowment for HBCUs [https://www.bet.com/article/3d5ktm/black-colleges-endowment-gap] lags behind that of other top colleges.

The private sector can do more by strengthening its partnerships with HBCUs, recruiting, promoting, and retaining the impressive minds emerging from these venerable institutions.

https://act.rokhanna.com/a/hbcu-funding-petition?contactdata=5ZeTxb7ZwxURbvX079orJMDLqu+NBhOdZx0/joS7ZbyOV9yrNuGKDZ3dXM37L4sjzFw1VEXKbNDIphC0bnJw8XG8lpqzgOysFrraw3P1z2x72nUOhoMCcMUybGp0zGiWpyPM8W5PZ7jLwvq7bUvtZw== [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/hbcu-funding-petition?contactdata=5ZeTxb7ZwxURbvX079orJMDLqu+NBhOdZx0/joS7ZbyOV9yrNuGKDZ3dXM37L4sjzFw1VEXKbNDIphC0bnJw8XG8lpqzgOysFrraw3P1z2x72nUOhoMCcMUybGp0zGiWpyPM8W5PZ7jLwvq7bUvtZw==]

That’s why I partnered with Dr. Jennifer Clyburn Reed to host the Silicon Valley HBCU Tech Summit at Claflin University. This valuable event brought together leaders from HBCUs, the Divine 9 Greek Houses, and leading Silicon Valley tech companies including Apple, Google, Microsoft, and Nvidia to discuss providing scholarships, jobs, and financial support to HBCU students and partnering with the universities.

However, Congress must also do its part by increasing funding for HBCUs. By providing greater opportunities for HBCU graduates to pursue careers in STEM, we open new doors to wealth generation in the digital age and strengthen our economy.

Sign the petition: Congress must increase funding for HBCUs. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/hbcu-funding-petition?contactdata=5ZeTxb7ZwxURbvX079orJMDLqu+NBhOdZx0/joS7ZbyOV9yrNuGKDZ3dXM37L4sjzFw1VEXKbNDIphC0bnJw8XG8lpqzgOysFrraw3P1z2x72nUOhoMCcMUybGp0zGiWpyPM8W5PZ7jLwvq7bUvtZw==]

Sign the Petition [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/hbcu-funding-petition?contactdata=5ZeTxb7ZwxURbvX079orJMDLqu+NBhOdZx0/joS7ZbyOV9yrNuGKDZ3dXM37L4sjzFw1VEXKbNDIphC0bnJw8XG8lpqzgOysFrraw3P1z2x72nUOhoMCcMUybGp0zGiWpyPM8W5PZ7jLwvq7bUvtZw==]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

In the latest of countless scandals involving the Biden
administration’s failure to secure the border, over half a million
illegal aliens with criminal histories are roaming freely in the
United States, 435,719 with convictions and another 226,847 with
pending charges. The Department of Homeland Security (DHS), created
after 9/11 to protect the country from another terrorist attack, has
released the foreign criminals in cities around the U.S., according to
the Deputy Director of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), the
DHS agency charged with “enforcing immigration laws to preserve
national security and public safety.” In figures reluctantly
provided to Congress ICE’s second in command, Patrick Lechleitner,
reveals that as of July 21, 2024 662,566 noncitizens with criminal
histories are on the agency’s “non-detained docket” and
therefore roaming freely throughout the country. The data
is “beyond disturbing,” said the Texas congressman, Republican
Tony Gonzales, who forced DHS to provide the records.

On September 3, the Department of Justice charged Hamas leadership with terrorism. Deputy Attorney General Lisa Monaco declared at the press conference announcing the charges that, "_We will not rest until all those who kidnapped or murdered Americans are brought to justice_." At that time I wrote a lengthy piece stating and [asking](https://substack.com/redirect/d314053c-953d-480a-93b0-e1369848b713?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> I am glad the Department of Justice is pursuing those who commit acts of violence and terrorism against the United States and its citizens--an obligation upon any sovereign nation. **The question is, when it comes to Palestine and Israel, why is the DOJ stopping with Hamas?**
I cited the Israeli killing of American citizens Shireen Abu Akleh, Jacob Flickinger, and several more--all killed without accountability. The Israeli military has since killed AyesaNur Ezgi Eygi, and now Israeli bombing kills yet another American citizen, Hajj Kamel Ahmad Jawad, again without accountability. The precedent this sets for any potential future MAGA administration is horrifying, and we need to talk about.
**Let 's Address This**.

American citizens killed by the Israeli military.
## Where is the accountability?
[Israeli strikes on Lebanon have killed 56-year-old Hajj Kamel Ahmad Jawad](https://substack.com/redirect/4ac56b3c-1f89-4fce-b3e8-16259ab3bc78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a Lebanese American father of four. Jawad's daughter Nadine Kamel Jawad stated:
> We are honored by my father's sacrifice. In his last days, he chose to stay near the main hospital in Nabatieh to help the elderly, disabled, injured, and those who simply couldn't financially afford to flee.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2cca198c-a37d-4fef-8f3f-ef139c587b8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Hajj Kamel Ahmad Jawad, a Lebanese American father of four, killed in Lebanon by Israeli bombing. Credit: ABC News
Jawad's killing at the hands of Israeli bombing comes after the U.S. State Department [declined to issue evacuation orders](https://substack.com/redirect/f503c3e4-bf3a-43d8-99b8-71d0f3504416?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to American citizens in Lebanon. Even now the State Department has asked citizens to procure their own flights if they want to leave, offering no meaningful assistance despite the devastating circumstances in Lebanon. Meanwhile, the Independent [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/4ac56b3c-1f89-4fce-b3e8-16259ab3bc78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> [Israeli airstrikes and military actions in Lebanon](https://substack.com/redirect/3fe9c34e-dfe4-413e-b2fe-96088eeaa2e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have killed more than 1,000 people, including dozens of children, and displaced a fifth of the population and wounded several thousand others, within the last two weeks.
Lebanon has a population of 5.5 million, meaning that Israeli bombing has already displaced at least 1.1 million innocent people. Worse, these circumstances were not a surprise. Politico cites six Israeli and American officials to report that while Biden publicly urged Netanyahu to exercise restraint, the [White House privately encouraged him to invade Lebanon](https://substack.com/redirect/944643e6-88a0-4174-9a4e-60b3ca5f4f34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--and to be quiet about that encouragement for PR purposes. Just as duplicative is a report from journalist Christine Amanpour, who uncovered that:
> Lebanon's Foreign Minister Abdallah Bou Habib tells CNN that Hezbollah leader Hassan Nasrallah had agreed to a 21-day ceasefire just before he was assassinated by Israel. The temporary ceasefire was called for by President Biden, President Macron and other allies during last week's UNGA. "He [Nasrallah] agreed, he agreed," Habib told [Amanpour] in an interview on Tuesday.
And as the final infuriating point to this discourage, Biden knows Netanyahu wants war, not peace--yet arms him anyway. Politico [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/468afbf2-a83f-43f7-9d4f-249ade9f4329?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Biden told confidants that he did not believe his Israeli counterpart wanted a cease-fire deal, arguing that Netanyahu was trying to perpetuate the conflict to save his political future and assist Trump in November's election, the officials said.
All the while, Americans killed by the Israeli government receive no justice, and Netanyahu and the Israeli government face no accountability.

## Biden's inaction must end
The American people are facing a reality in which the President promises to hold accountable anyone who kills an American citizen, yet repeatedly refuses to act when the culprit is Netanyahu. A President whose White House secretly urged Netanyahu to invade Lebanon, while refusing to call upon its own citizens to evacuate--which enabled the killing of yet another American citizen. A President who reportedly agreed to ceasefire from Hezbollah leadership, yet stood by as Netanyahu assassinated Nasrullah anyway. And a President whose State Department admits Netanyahu is committing war crimes, and who himself admits Netanyahu is not looking for peace because it will help Trump win in November, and yet continues to arm Netanyahu.
We know that Americans are tired of war, [that 77% of Democrats, 63% of moderates, and 61% of Republicans want to stop arming Netanyahu](https://substack.com/redirect/99e6abc4-cf6b-494f-961e-bd6423bc41ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And yet, despite the Leahy Laws and despite overwhelming support from the American people to do the right thing, Biden continues to arm Netanyahu. I cannot understand why the President is risking sacrificing American democracy at the alter of Benjamin Netanyahu--a man credibly accused of war crimes and genocide, and a man the President _knows_ is only looking to save his own political future.
President Biden promised that "_if you harm or kill an American, we will respond_." But so far the only response to Netanyahu harming and killing American citizens is to allow him to continue harming and killing American citizens. And given the 80,000 Lebanese American voters in the must win state of Michigan, I fear the impact this dereliction will have not just on the November election, but as dangerous precedent for a potential future President dictating under absolute Supreme Court immunity.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..z06mQadp1CCmPAhQTNSIZOT9WLFx0mf6Zn0PIR35HgQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149761063)
## Dangerous precedents for American Presidents
And that's perhaps most frightening of all. Imagine a future MAGA presidency in which Donald Trump calls dictators and credibly accused war criminals to secretly take out those American citizens causing him trouble? Meanwhile, he hides behind both SCOTUS immunity and the fact that President Biden faced no accountability for failing to act when foreign governments like Israel repeatedly killed American citizens.
If you think this is far fetched, remember that Donald Trump was ready to let insurrectionists hang Mike Pence, his own VP, if it meant keeping himself in the White House. Also remember the fascist [Project 2025 is clear that it intends to give Trump dictatorial authority](https://substack.com/redirect/08f04009-5956-44f7-ba4c-3d6af0c151d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Any nuance in who was killed and why won't be enough to hold Trump accountable. And the voices of those speaking up to condemn Trump's actions then, while they currently remain silent at Biden's inaction now, will not be enough.
Our Leahy Laws exist for a reason. International human rights laws exist for a reason. American sovereignty exists for a reason. We know MAGA Republicans will try to push the boundaries of abuse of power via Project 2025 and other avenues. They are telling us they will. We've seen it before. After President Obama unwisely expanded Bush's drone strike program, Donald Trump exponentially expanded it during his presidency and [increased civilians killed by drones by a shocking 330%](https://substack.com/redirect/96e252f4-8081-4857-876c-644b23d7ae2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). To prevent that from happening on an even greater scale in a potential future Trump (or any MAGA) presidency, we need to ensure our Democratic President emphatically enforces the laws and principles he was elected to uphold, not ignore them. This must be a non-negotiable. We must act for justice now.
Otherwise, I fear that a loss this November election, or a future MAGA presidency in general, will be the end of American democracy as we know it, and it will then be too late to act for justice.

During Tuesday night’s Vice Presidential debate, **Governor Tim Walz showed us that he’s serious about taking action to support care workers and families.**
With concrete, actionable steps, he discussed plans to expand access to affordable child care, aging and disability care, paid leave, and better wages for care workers.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94198423/502821446/598918572?ms=100324_VP_debate_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MGRlNmYxYS1hZDgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UOCnRX-z7RvnBhS-zfP2IQ73C71pYYt68Naop86yMic=&emci=8ab4d55b-8b81-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=80de6f1a-ad81-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)
JD Vance, on the other hand, **failed to explain how he and Donald Trump would address the care crisis.** Instead, he espoused harmful lies about immigrants and vague talking points.
[**_Read our full statement on the debate:_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94198424/502821447/1105190466?ms=100324_VP_debate_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MGRlNmYxYS1hZDgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UOCnRX-z7RvnBhS-zfP2IQ73C71pYYt68Naop86yMic=&emci=8ab4d55b-8b81-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=80de6f1a-ad81-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)
[READ MORE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94198425/502821448/1105190466?ms=100324_VP_debate_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MGRlNmYxYS1hZDgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UOCnRX-z7RvnBhS-zfP2IQ73C71pYYt68Naop86yMic=&emci=8ab4d55b-8b81-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=80de6f1a-ad81-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)
Let’s see how Vance and Walz’s plans stack up on care:
**The Trump-Vance ticket:**
* Has never fought for care
* Plans to weaken Medicaid and Medicare
* Will dismantle childcare programs like Head Start
* Has no plans to solve the care crisis

**The Harris-Walz ticket:**
* Has fought to raise wages for home care workers in Minnesota
* Expanded paid family leave in Minnesota
* Expanded the Child Tax Credit nationwide
* Plans to strengthen jobs for care workers
* Plans to invest in high-quality child care, aging care, and long‐term care

[**_Care is on the ballot, and we can’t afford to go backwards, Peter. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2016%2E135344%2Eg1EqDn)

Friend --
Trump will be in Saginaw, Michigan today for his 12th visit of the 2024 presidential campaign.
**I am asking for a contribution -- $3 or whatever you can afford -- before Donald Trump takes the stage today. If that's all you need to hear, please use this link to donate today:**
**[https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/-Trump-Visit](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241003-3-900&t=2&akid=2016%2E135344%2Eg1EqDn)**
Here's how former President Trump's visit plays in our race:
We know that both the presidential race and the Senate majority will be decided by Michigan – and recent polls show that our race is a dead heat.
Given that the Senate race is the top of the ticket in the state, we know that whatever happens in our race will impact the presidential, too. That’s why Trump has given Mike Rogers his full-throated endorsement -- and why he’s attacked me directly, by name, calling me a “far-left liberal lunatic.” We expect to hear that and more today, unfortunately.
He knows that in order to win Michigan, the Republican nominee needs to win the Senate race – and he’s going to do whatever he can to make that happen.
That means we can likely expect to see Trump in Michigan a lot more in the stretch -- especially since voting has started, meaning voters can start casting their ballots NOW. At the same time, national Republicans are doing everything they can to flip our state red and boost our opponent in the Senate race.
If we are going to keep this seat blue in November, we need to hold the line by keeping our own positive TV ads on the air, doubling down on our field outreach, and continuing to meet voters in every corner of the state.
[**Trump will be here today. It would be a huge boon to our campaign if you would chip in and show your support before Trump speaks this afternoon. Our goal is to send a message that we are NOT letting them win back Michigan! Even a single $5 or $10 contribution goes a long way when lots of folks are chipping in.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241003-3-900&t=3&akid=2016%2E135344%2Eg1EqDn)

Someone recently told me that our campaign rally had the biggest crowd they'd seen in St. Joe since Jerry Litton in 1976. And that's the kind of thing we're seeing all across Missouri -- from St. Joe to Ste. Genevieve and everywhere in between.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/9b7055cb-439a-483f-b2ed-983fa4f42dcb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Josh Hawley hasn't held a public campaign event in Missouri for weeks.
But these are the crowds at our recent events. Packed spaces with hundreds of Missourians who are fired up to defeat Josh Hawley and take back their U.S. Senate seat this November:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0ac08f3d-afd4-4d4b-9383-2fd3b3befa9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

**We 've got real momentum, and right now is the most impactful time to donate to our campaign. **If we can keep it up, if we can keep fighting the false attacks that Josh Hawley and his Super PAC are spending millions to air about me on TV, we can win this for working people everywhere.
With just 33 days until Election Day, our movement to take this U.S. Senate seat back for real Missourians has never been stronger. But we urgently need your help to keep this momentum going -- by holding big events, airing our message on TV, and holding Hawley accountable to voters across Missouri.
I hope you'll join us by pitching in whatever amount you can today to help defeat Josh Hawley and secure our freedoms on November 5th.

name: FRC Action
subject: Sign the Petition: Urge presidential candidates to support Israel!
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Dear Fellow American,

In July, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke before
a joint session of Congress. The night before, FRC Action
Chairman Tony Perkins had the privilege of meeting with the prime
minister and letting him know that many Bible-believing
Christians are praying for him, Israel, and the Jewish people.

After the horrific October 7 terrorist attack by Hamas, we have
seen antisemitism on display in our nation's cities and on
college campuses. We stand against this evil. As Prime Minister
Netanyahu said, "Wherever and whenever we see the scourge of
antisemitism, we must fight it, without exception."

As Israel fights for its survival, it is more important now
than ever that the United States stand with our ally. Israel
should be able to count on our support in its fight for its
survival. Sign the petition below encouraging President Biden and
American presidential candidates to commit to supporting Israel.

Sign the Pledge Now

To President Biden and the Presidential Candidates:

It is of great importance that the next president of the United
States commits to stand with our greatest ally in the Middle
East, Israel.

For decades, there has been bipartisan support for Israel.
Sadly, ever since the October 7 attack against Israel by Hamas
terrorists, this support has been put into question.

Given the existential threat Israel is facing, it should be a
priority of the current chief executive and every presidential
candidate to be loud and clear about their support for Israel.

We ask that you affirm America's commitment to Israel's
security and ensure that Israel maintains a qualitative military
edge over any and all adversaries.

We ask that you support Israel's right and obligation to defend
itself against terror attacks upon its people and against
alternative forms of warfare being waged upon it legally,
economically, culturally, and otherwise.

We ask that you make clear to the Israeli government that you
will be a willing partner in their fight for survival.

Sign the Pledge

God Bless,

Jody Hice

President, FRC Action

FRC Action

801 G Street NW, Washington, D.C. 20001

social welfare organization organized under section 501(c)(4) of

deductible as charitable contributions for income tax purposes.
Your contribution will be used in support of the general mission
of FRC Action. FRC Action does not accept contributions
designated or earmarked for the purpose of influencing an
election.

body:
Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races.... | | |
---
The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

**FLORIDA** – Senator **Rick Scott **(R) faces former Congresswoman **Debbie Mucarsel-Powell** (D) who is working hard to use the abortion issue against him while she voted to allow born-alive babies to be killed. A recent poll shows Scott leading by 3 points, but he's out swinging – exposing how "Socialist Debbie" backs higher taxes on Florida families while giving tax breaks to illegal immigrants. **OHIO** – Businessman **Bernie Moreno** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Sherrod Brown** (D) in the most expensive Senate race in the nation. Progressive donors are pouring money into the Buckeye State to save their favorite liberal. Sherrod Brown featured a Republican in a TV ad who supports him, but the man is actually a Democrat. This is what Moreno is up against – lies, lies, and more lies – yet he only trails Brown by 3 points. **MISSOURI** – Senator **Josh Hawley** (R) faces Marine veteran **Lucas Kunce** (D) who is pretending to be a centrist. In a recent debate, Kunce refused to say if he was going to vote for Kamala Harris for President, which is laughable given his liberal record. The fact that he would try to hide his support for Harris shows what low regard he has for Missouri voters. Recent polls show Hawley with the lead, but he's being outspent 2-to-1, so conservatives can't sleep on the race. **ARIZONA** – Former TV news anchor **Kari Lake** (R) is taking on Congressman **Ruben Gallego** (D) to fill the open seat held by retiring Senator Kyrsten Sinema (I). Gallego is one of the most liberal politicians in Congress – even to the left of Nancy Pelosi. Gallego voted against border security while voting to give voting rights to illegal immigrants. | **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

name: Jill Stein
subject: We do not consent to war
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
It’s time to stop the push for WWIII.

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, In just the past few days the situation in the Middle East has gotten even worse. Israel has invaded Lebanon in a massive escalation of its genocidal war on Gaza, and Iran has launched a barrage of missiles at Tel Aviv in response to Israel’s attacks on Lebanon, Syria, Yemen, Palestine, and Iran itself. If he wanted to, President Biden could stop this war with one phone call to the Israeli prime minister like Ronald Reagan did in 1982, because Israel’s war machine is completely dependent on US taxpayer-supplied weapons, money, military and diplomatic support. But instead, **the Biden-Harris administration is complicit in Benjamin Netanyahu’s plans to expand this horrific war.**
---
---
A bombshell Politico article titled “US officials quietly backed Israel’s push against Hezbollah” has revealed that top Biden administration officials encouraged Israel to invade Lebanon - completely contradicting the Democrats’ claim that Kamala Harris is “working tirelessly for a ceasefire”. Now the Middle East - and the world - are sitting on a powder keg as fears grow of an ever-expanding war that could even go nuclear. **We do not consent to be dragged into World War III by Netanyahu** to support his genocidal land grab in Palestine, Lebanon, and beyond. By allowing Netanyahu to essentially dictate US foreign policy, Biden and Harris have abdicated the responsibility of their office. As President, the first thing I’ll do is make the phone call to stop this madness at once and fix the crisis at its source - by ceasing all weapons and support to Israel until it ends its genocide in Gaza and agrees to negotiate a settlement for Palestine and the region consistent with international law and the rulings of the International Court of Justice. **We are the only campaign with a path to the White House that is putting opposition to empire, war and genocide front and center - and we are building a movement that won’t stop until we end these endless wars** **and achieve lasting peace with justice for all.** Recent polling from the Council on American Islamic Relations shows that our campaign is actually leading both Harris and Trump among Muslim voters in key states. And the more we can get our message out, the more our numbers will grow. [**Will you pitch in today to help us reach millions of voters with our anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action message in the critical final weeks before Election Day?**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=israel_lebanon_iran_10_3&n=1)
---
