---
We're grateful for the strong support of Muslim voters who share with us the determination to end genocide in Gaza, and the injustice faced by our Muslim friends and others around the world. Our message is clear: we urge all people of conscience to resist the propaganda telling you to hold your nose and vote for genocide. If you vote for genocide, you are actively consenting to it and enabling it. Don’t let them talk you out of your humanity. Stopping genocide is the moral imperative of our time. **As Frederick Douglass said,_power concedes nothing without a demand._ Your vote is that demand.** Voting for the “lesser evil” twists your opposition to genocide into consent for genocide. We say forget the “lesser evil” and fight for the greater good like our lives depend on it - _because they do._ Every vote against genocide is a shot across the bow of the empire, announcing that its days are numbered and that the opposition is getting organized. The political elites want you to think you are small and powerless, and that resistance is futile. This is a propaganda campaign to disarm you. In fact, a large majority of Americans want an immediate ceasefire and diplomatic solution to the genocide on Gaza. On top of that, one in three eligible voters didn’t vote in 2020, with those voters being mostly young, low-income, and people of color - the very voters our anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action agenda speaks to by calling for an end to genocide now, a weapons embargo to Israel, a $25 minimum wage, health care as a human right through Medicare for All, free public higher education, national rent control, reparations, a real Green New Deal, and an end to mass incarceration and police violence. We can pay for these programs by cutting the massively bloated military budget and making the rich pay their fair share of taxes. **We _can_ have an America that works for all of us.** It begins by ending the genocide and moving from a militarized foreign policy to a new foreign policy based on international law, human rights and diplomacy - and moving the trillions squandered on endless war to the urgent needs of the American people here at home. **Our message is resonating with voters across the country, but we have just weeks left to reach millions of people who are hungry for a better choice.[Please donate whatever you can today to help us get our message out and build the movement to put an end to war for good!](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=israel_lebanon_iran_10_3&n=4)**

You may have heard about Mitch McConnell's $22.5 million investment to defeat us in Michigan, but I wanted to weigh in personally about what this means for our race.
First and foremost, I've heard from a number of people that maybe they think we're going to win this race because this is Michigan and Democrats win in Michigan.
Um, no.
Michigan is a swing state, full stop. And just because it's swung to Democrats in the last election or two, it can swing right back. It was not too long ago that Trump won here once before – by just 10,704 votes.
And if you need further evidence of that - look at the McConnell super PAC buy to beat us.
Mitch McConnell is many things, but he is no fool. He is not going to take $22.5 million and light it on fire. He could spend that in a lot of other places, but he chose to spend it to defeat me.
And that's because they think they can win here.
He's right.
They can win here.
Mike Rogers could win and carry Donald Trump over the finish line here as well.
But that will not happen if we have the resources to respond to this McConnell ad buy.
That's why I am turning to you. Because emails like this are a single greatest source of fundraising for our campaign at this point.
So if you want to make sure Democrats hold Michigan's Senate seat, please split a donation between Tim Kaine and my campaign today. It can be $5, $50 or anything you can afford. Because it will all add up fast if we all chip in. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]

name: John Avlon
subject: Now it’s time to fight back
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-happy-warrior?refcode=1003 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-happy-warrior?refcode=1003]
Friends,
It looks like No-Show Nick’s far right dark money funders have figured out the only way he can win is to flood the district with false attacks. That’s what you get from a Trump flunky.
It’s pretty funny if you think about it: I was accused of being a secret Republican in the primary, and now I’m accused of being a hyper-partisan liberal in the general election. You can’t be both.
The truth is that I’m a believer in a strong and vital center - and I believe that the positive defeats the negative - which is why we’ve been laying out a positive vision for change based on common-sense problem solving and bringing people together.
But LaLota is just going to keep running these false ads all the way up to Election Day in hopes that he won’t have to tell voters the truth about how extreme he is on abortion, how he broke his promises on SALT, or how he helped kill the bipartisan border security bill.

subject: If you have been waiting for the right time to get involved, this is it.
body:

|
California Democrats,
**If you have been waiting for the right time to get involved, this is it**. County Election Officials will begin to mail out ballots starting next week, marking the beginning of the 2024 voting season.
To take back the House, we know we need to talk to Latino voters in the Central Valley. For the past two years, we’ve done just that. However, we need more bilingual Spanish speakers to reach even more voters and ensure everyone has a plan to vote.
According to the UCLA Latino Data Hub, a plurality (48%) of Latino-eligible voters in California are bilingual and can be contacted in both English and Spanish. However, significant numbers of other Latino-eligible voters speak only English (34%) or only Spanish (18%).
Will you help us reach them in this critical time in the election? The future of the House depends on us.

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: Across the Country: October 3rd, 2024
body:
North Carolina has an urgent need for support after Hurricane Helene.
| | | | | |
---
**_Across the Country_**
---
|
---
Hello, folks! Welcome back to _Across the Country_ , our weekly series at No Dem Left Behind! We’re diving into the most pressing issues impacting the heartland of America as the 2024 election approaches. These are the stories that actually matter to our communities. Let’s stay informed, together. –Daniela Rodriguez
---
| | | | **North Carolina**
---
|
---
North Carolina is grappling with the devastating aftermath of Hurricane Helene, which has tragically resulted in the loss of over 200 lives across the state. This immense tragedy highlights the urgent need for assistance as communities face severe flooding and extensive damage to homes and infrastructure. For locals, this means they are unable to attend work or school, as the aftermath has left much uncertainty regarding the reopening of schools and the resumption of daily life. In response to this crisis, President Biden has approved major disaster declarations for North Carolina, Florida, and South Carolina, allowing survivors to access emergency funds and resources to jumpstart their recovery immediately. FEMA and other federal agencies, along with private businesses and nonprofit and faith-based organizations, are mobilizing to respond to the disaster in at least seven states, from Florida to Virginia. Residents are not only dealing with physical damage but also the emotional toll of the disaster. Many families have been displaced, and the loss of homes and livelihoods has created a deep sense of urgency for support. The community is rallying together, but the scale of the destruction requires significant federal assistance. A preliminary study from the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory has indicated that climate change contributed to the hurricane's intensity, causing 50% more rainfall in some areas of Georgia and the Carolinas. This correlation emphasized the urgent need for climate action to combat the climate crisis as part of any recovery effort. While Biden’s administration has prioritized immediate aid for affected states, the previous administration under Trump often downplayed the severity of such disasters. Hours before Helene made landfall, Trump dismissed the climate crisis and inaccurately claimed that nuclear "warming" was the greater concern. His administration's lack of adequate response to similar disasters left many vulnerable populations without the support they needed during critical times. These critical times call for collective action from our community leaders and elected officials. The severity of the hurricane and its ongoing consequences are not to be taken likely, but as a devastating reminder that we need to fight against a very real climate crisis that continues to affect all Americans everywhere. Climate change is not a hoax, it’s time to DO SOMETHING before it’s too late. **Join us next week with Sabrina for the latest updates on nationwide breaking news. Make sure to stay informed with NDLB!**
---
|
---
-Daniela Rodriguez

---
The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

A recent poll shows Scott leading by 3 points, but he's out swinging – exposing how "Socialist Debbie" backs higher taxes on Florida families while giving tax breaks to illegal immigrants. **OHIO** – Businessman **Bernie Moreno** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Sherrod Brown** (D) in the most expensive Senate race in the nation. Progressive donors are pouring money into the Buckeye State to save their favorite liberal. Sherrod Brown featured a Republican in a TV ad who supports him, but the man is actually a Democrat. This is what Moreno is up against – lies, lies, and more lies – yet he only trails Brown by 3 points. **MISSOURI** – Senator **Josh Hawley** (R) faces Marine veteran **Lucas Kunce** (D) who is pretending to be a centrist. In a recent debate, Kunce refused to say if he was going to vote for Kamala Harris for President, which is laughable given his liberal record. The fact that he would try to hide his support for Harris shows what low regard he has for Missouri voters. Recent polls show Hawley with the lead, but he's being outspent 2-to-1, so conservatives can't sleep on the race. **ARIZONA** – Former TV news anchor **Kari Lake** (R) is taking on Congressman **Ruben Gallego** (D) to fill the open seat held by retiring Senator Kyrsten Sinema (I). Gallego is one of the most liberal politicians in Congress – even to the left of Nancy Pelosi. Gallego voted against border security while voting to give voting rights to illegal immigrants. name: Jill Stein
subject: Florida left 3K people in cages in the path of a hurricane
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prison_justice&n=1)
---
Peter,

Wakulla County Florida was under an emergency evacuation order.

Hurricane Helene was on the way, due to plow into the Florida coastline and later grind its way up through Georgia, South Carolina, North Carolina and Tennessee.

Residents in this low-lying, coastal county south of Tallahassee heeded the warnings and got out. But some people got left behind on purpose.

Prison officials made the conscious decision to leave 3,000 incarcerated citizens held in the Wakulla Correctional Institution, directly in the path of this deadly storm.

Their families were so desperate for information, they resorted to leaving comments on local news reports:
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prison_justice&n=2)
---
While Wakulla County wasn’t hit quite as hard as some other areas, the question remains: **If an emergency evacuation order was put in place to preserve human life, why weren’t incarcerated people part of that evacuation?

** We know the answer, because we’ve seen this movie before. 19 years ago, as Hurricane Katrina slammed into New Orleans, THOUSANDS of inmates were left behind despite mandatory evacuations.

Pointedly, **the sheriff there said he was leaving the inmates “where they belong."**
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prison_justice&n=3)
---
**Some of those prisoners were juveniles as young as 10 years old. Some were in jail for minor offenses like public intoxication, waiting for a hearing because they couldn’t afford bail.

** Long after the waters receded from that devastating storm, there is still no official death toll of the people left behind in cages, trapped by rising floodwaters. We do know that **a subsequent Human Rights Watch report concluded nearly 600 incarcerated Americans were listed as “unaccounted for.”

** These are the obvious outcomes of a criminal legal system designed to humiliate and dehumanize people. **It has nothing whatsoever to do with public safety.

** While Donald Trump plots mass deportations and concentration camps for immigrants and political enemies alike, and Kamala Harris boasts about her work as California’s “Top Cop” – even keeping inmates incarcerated for longer to protect their “prison labor pool – I am the only candidate in this race with a path to the White House and a [**comprehensive, transformational reform plan for prisons and policing**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prison_justice&n=4#prisons_and_policing).

[**If you believe, as I do, that our current incarceration system is as inhumane as it is fundamentally unsustainable, please join me with a donation to our campaign to bring our call for justice to the ballot box.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prison_justice&n=5)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prison_justice&n=6 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prison_justice&n=6)
---
Our platform recognizes that public safety and justice can only be achieved by preserving human dignity and safeguarding human rights.

We will dismantle the prison industrial complex and end mass incarceration as we know it. My administration will guarantee as a human right a restorative criminal justice system that treats every one of the over 2.3 million people in federal, state, and local prisons and jails with respect, dignity and compassion.

As long as America maintains the current system, we will continue to see the barbarity, the total disregard for human life, and the immeasurable cruelty expand to impact more people.

It must end, and under my administration, it will.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prison_justice&n=7 "Support Jill Today!") body:
Are you ready to vote? Early voting is going on NOW in most states.

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=1)
---
Thursday, October 03, 2024 | Peter -- It's election season again! The election is fewer than 40 days away now, and early voting has started in many states. There are so many good candidates and causes on the ballot this year - make sure you don't miss out.
### Step 1: Check Your Registration And Figure Out When And How To Vote In Your State
Each state is different, but in many, early and mail-in voting has already started. You can check how your state votes here: | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=T0vecgcUFukW10ADWgvADP4Vvp603xNXHIOBdT2Ssc8&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=2 "When And How Can I Vote?") [When And How Can I Vote?](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=T0vecgcUFukW10ADWgvADP4Vvp603xNXHIOBdT2Ssc8&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=2)
---
### Step 2: Find Your Local Forward Candidate To Support
Forward has candidates on the ballot in states across the country, from school board to U.S. Senate. Be sure to check out our candidates page to find the one near you and give them your support!
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/endorsements?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=3 "Find Forward Candidates") [Find Forward Candidates](https://home.forwardparty.com/endorsements?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=3)
---
### Step 3: Support Good Government Ballot Measures
There's more than just candidates on the line this November. There are dozens of crucial election reform measures in states across the country. There are referendums for open primaries, ranked-choice voting, independent redistricting commissions, and more. Find out which ones are in your area in this great guide from our friends at FairVote.
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=0xj462lKowoTlM5xyWdYNAkSdT8Br7tf8BXPwvyszu2_ndVfEfdmAIGonGHk62Ld&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=4 "Find Local Ballot Measures") [Find Local Ballot Measures](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=0xj462lKowoTlM5xyWdYNAkSdT8Br7tf8BXPwvyszu2_ndVfEfdmAIGonGHk62Ld&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=4)
---
This election season is crucial, and you can make the difference. Make sure you've got a plan, know your candidates, have found your ballot measures, and then _**get out there and vote! And don't forget to bring friends!**_
### Additional Voting Tools
We've got two additional tools we want to highlight for you all that we think might make a huge difference this election season.
The first is a tool out of Princeton's [Electoral Innovation Lab](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=1_08ARGQPY9k72ah0UeV0HJt1l9VBVhV2c0r_XoYzoc&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=5) called [Vote Maximizer.](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=ihU6dxQApWhDfn3sWyy-kiRYRUh63Zzd5Y--3aPKnn0&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=6) Vote Maximizer is a fantastic tool that analyzes voter power for a single voter in each district in the country based on how much impact their single vote will have.
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=ihU6dxQApWhDfn3sWyy-kiRYRUh63Zzd5Y--3aPKnn0&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=7)
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=ihU6dxQApWhDfn3sWyy-kiRYRUh63Zzd5Y--3aPKnn0&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=8 "Check Out Vote Maximizer") [Check Out Vote Maximizer](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=ihU6dxQApWhDfn3sWyy-kiRYRUh63Zzd5Y--3aPKnn0&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=8)
---
The second tool we want to highlight is this database of [election deniers](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=znODmCwpY44lBF9Acw55Lv1n1Dmur7I8aY9uOTfkfxw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=9). The 2020 election wasn't stolen, and continued claims to the contrary are eroding our democracy. Candidates who peddle in these claims are unworthy of holding public office. Knowing if any such candidates are running in your area can help you determine for whom you should vote.
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=znODmCwpY44lBF9Acw55Lv1n1Dmur7I8aY9uOTfkfxw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=10 "Find Election Deniers In Your District") [Find Election Deniers In Your District](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=znODmCwpY44lBF9Acw55Lv1n1Dmur7I8aY9uOTfkfxw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_newsletter_send_1&n=10)
---
We'll see you out there, voting to build a healthier democracy!

clean_body: Are you ready to vote? Early voting is going on NOW in most states. | | Thursday, October 03, 2024 | Peter -- It's election season again! The election is fewer than 40 days away now, and early voting has started in many states. There are so many good candidates and causes on the ballot this year - make sure you don't miss out. Step 1: Check Your Registration And Figure Out When And How To Vote In Your State Each state is different, but in many, early and mail-in voting has already started. You can check how your state votes here: | "When And How Can I Vote?" Step 2: Find Your Local Forward Candidate To Support Forward has candidates on the ballot in states across the country, from school board to U.S. Senate. Be sure to check out our candidates page to find the one near you and give them your support! "Find Forward Candidates" Step 3: Support Good Government Ballot Measures There's more than just candidates on the line this November. There are dozens of crucial election reform measures in states across the country. There are referendums for open primaries, ranked-choice voting, independent redistricting commissions, and more. Find out which ones are in your area in this great guide from our friends at FairVote. "Find Local Ballot Measures" This election season is crucial, and you can make the difference. Make sure you've got a plan, know your candidates, have found your ballot measures, and then get out there and vote! And don't forget to bring friends! Additional Voting Tools We've got two additional tools we want to highlight for you all that we think might make a huge difference this election season. The first is a tool out of Princeton's called Vote Maximizer is a fantastic tool that analyzes voter power for a single voter in each district in the country based on how much impact their single vote will have. "Check Out Vote Maximizer" The second tool we want to highlight is this database of . The 2020 election wasn't stolen, and continued claims to the contrary are eroding our democracy. Peter,
By all accounts, I shouldn’t be alive.

As a Green Beret, I embarked on some of the most dangerous missions of our military.

I fought terrorists face to face, and I came within inches of America’s worst enemies.

It’s a new month, so first, I want to say thank you. Your involvement with the Jane Fonda Climate PAC means so much to me, especially now. We’re in the midst of an unprecedented climate crisis, and it’s clearer than ever that none of us can face it alone. **Make no mistake: If the 5th Circuit decides to end DACA without a safety net of other protections in place, the consequences for our country will be catastrophic.**
If DACA renewals are halted, it would mean that for **each month** over the next two years, some **1,600** DACA recipients working in health care, including doctors and nurses, **800** educational professionals like teachers and teacher aides, and **600** personal care workers in child or senior care would be forced out of their jobs.
Losing DACA wouldn’t just affect the hundreds of thousands of immigrant youth who rely on the program to live and work free from the fear of deportation. We would feel ripple effects in our schools, hospitals, senior centers, and across the country.
**But the reality is that the Biden Administration, Congress, and even our state and local elected officials do not have to wait for the courts to rule to deliver urgent protections for our communities.** They can act right now to protect the hundreds of thousands of DACA recipients and those who rely on them.
Anything short of delivering urgent protections for our communities is _reckless_ and would intentionally leave hundreds of thousands of peoples’ lives on the line.

clean_body: This latest DACA hearing could decide the fate of the program | | | Peter, We are ONE WEEK AWAY from the 5th Circuit DACA hearing that could decide the program’s fate. This is the second time the 5th Circuit will rule on the DACA program, after their negative decision two years ago. Any decision they make will likely get appealed to the Supreme Court — which we know is now packed with conservative judges. We don’t have much time left to prepare for the hearing one week from today. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | Make no mistake: If the 5th Circuit decides to end DACA without a safety net of other protections in place, the consequences for our country will be catastrophic. If DACA renewals are halted, it would mean that for each month over the next two years, some 1,600 DACA recipients working in health care, including doctors and nurses, 800 educational professionals like teachers and teacher aides, and 600 personal care workers in child or senior care would be forced out of their jobs. Losing DACA wouldn’t just affect the hundreds of thousands of immigrant youth who rely on the program to live and work free from the fear of deportation. We would feel ripple effects in our schools, hospitals, senior centers, and across the country. But the reality is that the Biden Administration, Congress, and even our state and local elected officials do not have to wait for the courts to rule to deliver urgent protections for our communities. They can act right now to protect the hundreds of thousands of DACA recipients and those who rely on them. Anything short of delivering urgent protections for our communities is reckless and would intentionally leave hundreds of thousands of peoples’ lives on the line. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | This has been the story of DACA ever since its inception — immigrant youth and allies responding to unrelenting attacks and fighting for our livelihoods. We don’t know what the future holds for the program that has been a lifeline for so many undocumented people, but that won’t stop us from demanding more from the elected officials who promised to protect immigrant communities. A better future with permanent protections for all 11 million is possible, but not without your support, NAME/friend. Thank you. body:
Peter, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important.
**When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital.** When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future.
But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition."
Peter, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that.
**Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.**
Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need.
So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican megadonors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules.
The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help, Peter.

* **TOP NEWS**

**" West Texas geyser spews oil-laced water near Toyah and Interstate 20,"** Houston Chronicle's**Amanda Drane** -- "A tower of salty water that appears to be laced with oil is shooting roughly 100 feet into the sky just West of Toyah in Reeves County, [an area of West Texas](https://substack.com/redirect/be6e1588-c423-45e5-b850-45fabbfc1041?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) plagued by a recent rash of earthquakes linked to wastewater injection.

It was unclear where the water was coming from Wednesday. A Texas Railroad Commission map showed there was a dry hole in the area of the geyser. The Commission, which regulates the state's oil and gas industry, could not be immediately reached.

The commission has been [working to limit](https://substack.com/redirect/0d214043-758a-4284-aa46-ffd9da220386?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) wastewater injection in the area where the geyser was reported. In December, it told operators that it plans to suspend permits allowing the injection of wastewater deep underground, after staff determined that deep injection was "likely contributing to recent seismic activity."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/7e732c2b-5843-4329-8997-105eb431258b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Reeves County Emergency Management and representatives from Kinder Morgan were on scene at the geyser just off of Interstate 20 Wednesday afternoon. The smell of oil and rotten eggs -- a telltale [sign of poisonous hydrogen sulfide gas](https://substack.com/redirect/4e01e87e-8328-4396-9d9b-219d6032fe64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- wafted through the area. A first responder said he measured 250 parts per million of the gas.

Kinder Morgan said in a statement that its staff investigated and determined the geyser was unrelated to their pipeline operations in the area.

Oil and gas attorney Sarah Stogner and well control specialist Hawk Dunlap, working for Antina Ranch, were also onsite Wednesday after hearing reports of the geyser. The pair have become [first responders of sorts](https://substack.com/redirect/5c6713f1-01f9-4f5d-a21d-db5710b255a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) themselves as the area is affected by so-called "[zombie" wells](https://substack.com/redirect/53c799bd-d301-4f24-8bb1-c450936c8c3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), or wells that should be plugged but are bursting back to life with toxic water.

It was unclear where the water was coming from Wednesday. A Texas Railroad Commission map showed there was a dry hole in the area of the geyser. The Commission, which regulates the state's oil and gas industry, could not be immediately reached.

The commission has been [working to limit](https://substack.com/redirect/ec268e08-198e-4743-9790-ab0c9f1a10c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) wastewater injection in the area where the geyser was reported. Reeves County Emergency Management and representatives from Kinder Morgan were on scene at the geyser just off of Interstate 20 Wednesday afternoon. It was unclear where the water was coming from Wednesday. A Texas Railroad Commission map showed there was a dry hole in the area of the geyser. The Commission, which regulates the state's oil and gas industry, could not be immediately reached. The commission has been wastewater injection in the area where the geyser was reported. In December, it told operators that it plans to suspend permits allowing the injection of wastewater deep underground, after staff determined that deep injection was "likely contributing to recent seismic activity." Reeves County Emergency Management and representatives from Kinder Morgan were on scene at the geyser just off of Interstate 20 Wednesday afternoon. The smell of oil and rotten eggs -- a telltale -- wafted through the area. A first responder said he measured 250 parts per million of the gas. Kinder Morgan said in a statement that its staff investigated and determined the geyser was unrelated to their pipeline operations in the area. Oil and gas attorney Sarah Stogner and well control specialist Hawk Dunlap, working for Antina Ranch, were also onsite Wednesday after hearing reports of the geyser. The pair have become themselves as the area is affected by so-called ", or wells that should be plugged but are bursting back to life with toxic water. Reeves County Emergency Manager Jerry Bullard declined to comment about the geyser, saying the county has little incentive to shout it from the rooftops when such things occur because most of the county budget comes from taxes paid by the oil and gas industry." name: Michelle Dorothy, Chief Political Advisor
subject: Quick Houlahan Race Update
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chrissy Houlahan for Congress
body:
All eyes are on Pennsylvania and we are working hard to deliver the White House to Kamala Harris. Here is a quick snapshot of what we’ve been up to lately:

On the Ground: Republicans have made enormous voter registration gains in the last few years, leaving Democrats with the smallest advantage – just a few percent – in decades. So...most of us in the region are doing both persuasion and turnout, and our robust field operation is canvassing seven days a week, coordinating closely up and down the ballot, and has already knocked on over 18,000 doors.

Harris-Walz: They have 50 offices in the state and over 350 staff. We’re working closely with their team, which is why Chrissy recently spent a Sunday morning at a Women for Harris breakfast in Lancaster (not our district). Chrissy is active on the Harris-Walz National Advisory Board and is also, as a Polish American herself who has been a consistent advocate for Ukraine, leading PA’s Polish outreach efforts.

Opponent: Our district is a purple place with a good mix of urban, suburban, and rural. Voter registration is roughly 40% Democrat, 40% Republican, and 20% Independent. Chrissy is running against a high school teacher who talks about school reform, public safety, inflation, and Israel. If you’re up our way, you can see him driving a giant campaign bus around the district.

Campaign Spending: We are spending a lot on field staff and everything to support those efforts (software, yard signs, T-shirts, bumper stickers, food for volunteers), direct mail, field, online advertising, field, radio advertising, and more field. Thank you for supporting this effort.
In the News: Chrissy was on CBS’s Face the Nation recently to talk about her appointment to, and the latest news from, the task force investigating the attempted assassination of Donald Trump. She was recognized for being the 20th most bipartisan member of the House. She continues to push for better training for members on handling classified information . She just wrapped up her 90th town hall (90th!) – which is more than anyone else in the Pennsylvania delegation. Not that we’re competitive or anything. 😊

Thank you for being on this journey with us!

Michelle Dorothy
Chrissy Houlahan for Congress

It’s crystal clear to me after this debate that my opponent is the wrong choice for Virginia. My top priority is building an economy that will help Virginians thrive. We’re creating jobs, we’re lowering costs, and we’re making sure tax cuts are going to the middle class, not major corporations and the wealthiest 1%. We’re fighting for the essential human rights that every American deserves — from reproductive freedom to voting rights to the right to get necessary medical care without going broke. And we’re doing all of that together — not pushing people apart or tearing them down. I hope I made you proud last night, and if I did, I’m asking for your support so I can win this election and deliver Virginia for Democrats. Will you split 10 bucks between me and Mark Warner to help us win? = Thanks so much. -Tim Sent from my iPad **= | | Friends of Mark Warner 1490-5A Quarterpath Road #213 Williamsburg, VA 23185 United States | Click here to . | Paid for by Friends of Mark Warner

But that will not happen if we have the resources to respond to this McConnell ad buy.
That's why I am turning to you. Because emails like this are a single greatest source of fundraising for our campaign at this point.

Team: Texas Gov. Greg Abbott trumpeted Texas' purging of more than 1,000,000 voters under their 2021 voter suppression law. “ That removal process has been, and will continue to be, ongoing ,” Abbot’s office said.
Partisan election officials conduct these mass registered voter removals, as required by recent Texas voter suppression laws -- laws that include limits on mail-in ballots, drop boxes, laws targeting only Harris County (home to Houston), and so much more.
T hese purges disenfranchise legitimate registered voters who haven’t moved or had other changes to their status as voters . It's legalized voter suppression at its worst.
Abbott's office continues to malign voters without proof. " Illegal voting in Texas will never be tolerated. The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

name: The Democratic National Committee
subject: Can we try again, Derek?
body:
---
We've sent several messages trying to explain why a well-timed donation to the DNC was the best way for someone to contribute to and make a difference in this election. We talked about the work we're doing to reach the relatively small number of voters in the relatively small number of states and races that will determine control of the White House, House, and Senate. Maybe you've missed these messages. Maybe they weren't compelling enough. So we hope you'll give us a second to try again with a new approach -- because, truly, Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats everywhere need the DNC to have the resources to fund our plans to win this November. Let's start with what we're asking for. $3. body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
There are only a few days left to check your registration status and make sure you are registered to vote in Texas! Please help us spread the word. The deadline for registering to vote in Texas is this Monday, October 7.
It’s particularly important this year that Texans double-check their registration status. After passing a sweeping package of voting restrictions, Governor Abbott and Texas Republicans purged 1 million Texans from the voter rolls and there are reports that they might be on the brink of purging another 1 million voters from the rolls.
We’ve already heard from active voters who have been affected. No one should assume their registration status—they should check it!
That’s why we’re getting the word out to as many Texans as possible before the registration deadline. You can check your registration here—where you can also find voter registration forms [https://teamrv-mvp.sos.texas.gov/MVP/voterDetails.do] . (If you’re mailing in a registration form, it must be postmarked by October 7.)
If your registration is up to date, great! Take the next step and forward this email to friends and family to help them make sure theirs are, too.
These elections are as important as any we’ve ever had. The stakes are high, and we all need to show up at the ballot box. Today is the day to make sure we all can.
Thanks,
Team Lizzie

Well, Peter, it’s officially fall. We’ve been focused on November’s existential election, with so many state-level races that are must-wins for democracy. But fall also brings with it **a new term of Supreme Court oral arguments.** A recent poll found that as many as _seven in 10_ Americans think that the U.S. Supreme Court justices are driven by ideology. That’s a significant amount of folks disappointed in the status quo. Thankfully, President Biden has a bold new plan to reform the Supreme Court and protect the rule of law:
1. No immunity for crimes a former president committed while in office
2. 18-year term limits for Supreme Court justicesA binding code of conduct for the Supreme Court

A.G. Holder, who has long championed similar reforms to strengthen the Supreme Court, said: **“These proposals will ensure justices bend less to partisan winds and special interests and move toward a fair evaluation of the law.”** [**President Biden’s plan is a HUGE step forward, Peter. ## ****The Inconsistent and Ineffective Council Meetings in College Park
| | |
---
|
### Dear Neighbors,
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
[](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0MjEwMjEwNjY0Mjg2MDM2LFwiclwiOjEzNDIxMDIxMTM1NDI0ODI0MX0iLCJzIjoiMDM2OGE4MDgzZmZhNmRjMiJ9) [](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0MjEwMjEwNjY5NTI4OTIwLFwiclwiOjEzNDIxMDIxMTM1NDI0ODI0MX0iLCJzIjoiOWUzMGFiNWNmOGFiOTMxMCJ9) [](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0MjEwMjEwNjczNzIzMjI3LFwiclwiOjEzNDIxMDIxMTM1NDI0ODI0MX0iLCJzIjoiZjVhY2I1ZDFlMzEyYjc5MiJ9) As many of you may already know, our upcoming council meeting, originally scheduled for Monday, October 7th, has now been moved to **Thursday, October 10th** , citing a lack of quorum. This shift may not seem like a big deal at first glance, but let’s dig a little deeper into what’s really happening here.

In order for a meeting to take place in College Park, we must have a quorum—a minimum number of council members present to make decisions. Our city’s council is made up of four members, and if two of them are absent, the meeting cannot proceed. These [meeting disruptions began last November](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0MjEwMjEwNjc3OTE3NTM1LFwiclwiOjEzNDIxMDIxMTM1NDI0ODI0MX0iLCJzIjoiYzU0NGMxZmRkYWRmOWQwNCJ9) when members of the former council decided to stop showing up to work. Unfortunately this growing pattern of arbitrary and inconsistent meeting changes has continued with this "new" council.
| | |
---
|
### So many questions...
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
[](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0MjEwMjEwNjgyMTExODQyLFwiclwiOjEzNDIxMDIxMTM1NDI0ODI0MX0iLCJzIjoiNDdiMTUzMGZiZGEyYTVjOSJ9)******Why does this matter?

** When these elected officials ran for office, they were fully aware of the meeting schedule. Meetings in the City of College Park take place on the first and third Mondays of every month, with some flexibility around holidays. It’s a schedule that’s predictable, reliable, and necessary for the smooth governance of our city.

But there’s another important factor to consider: **the impact on staff.** Moving meetings around or adding Special Called meetings creates an additional burden on the city staff who handle the preparation and follow-up for each meeting. There is a natural rhythm to any organization’s regular functions, and when that rhythm is disrupted, it often leads to duplicated work, confusion, and inefficiencies. The time and energy staff put into preparing for meetings—whether creating materials, organizing agendas, or handling follow-ups—is wasted when these changes occur. It’s not just about rescheduling; it’s about the ripple effect these changes have on everyone behind the scenes and the diminished left in it's wake.

**So why are meetings being moved?** [Not only was our upcoming meeting shifted](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0MjEwMjEwNjg4NDAzMzAyLFwiclwiOjEzNDIxMDIxMTM1NDI0ODI0MX0iLCJzIjoiMGM1YjNkNDViNDI0N2Q3YyJ9), other meetings have been set at inconvenient times. Take, for example, the special-called meeting that took place **Monday morning at 8:00 AM on September 23rd**. One Council member, with a well known full-time job, was unable to attend. By scheduling meetings at times that certain council members simply cannot attend, this is effectively blocking an entire ward's participation in our city. When you silence a council member, you silence the voice of everyone in that ward who voted for them. This particular meeting was where we chose our current City Manager.

This isn’t just an issue of convenience; [it’s a question of transparency and accountability](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0MjEwMjEwNjkyNTk3NjEwLFwiclwiOjEzNDIxMDIxMTM1NDI0ODI0MX0iLCJzIjoiNWU4MWQ4MGRjNjIxMTM3NCJ9). If meetings are constantly shifted to fit the schedules of a select few, how can we trust that our voices are being heard and that decisions are being made with the full council present?
[](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0MjEwMjEwNjk3ODQwNDkzLFwiclwiOjEzNDIxMDIxMTM1NDI0ODI0MX0iLCJzIjoiZjI2ZDYxODAyNThjNDRlMSJ9)
| |
---
|
---
**Let’s talk about how time is spent during these meetings.**

To put it bluntly, **a lot of time is wasted**. What should be a space for open discussion and decision-making is often reduced to a procedural exercise where most key decisions are bundled into a **Consent Agenda**. Instead of discussing and debating important issues publicly, they are approved en masse with little to no conversation. **If you blink, you’ll miss it.** And then there’s the [lack of ](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0MjEwMjEwNzA0MTMxOTUzLFwiclwiOjEzNDIxMDIxMTM1NDI0ODI0MX0iLCJzIjoiN2ViMTIxZWNhOWY2NDQxMiJ9)**[City Manager& Attorney Reports](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0MjEwMjEwNzA5Mzc0ODM4LFwiclwiOjEzNDIxMDIxMTM1NDI0ODI0MX0iLCJzIjoiZGMzMDA2YzUyODhjOWExMCJ9)**, as well as, issues of **Mayor and Council Reports**. At the September 16th meeting, nearly **50 minutes** —almost half of the meeting—were spent on the council patting themselves on the back. Shouldn’t more time be dedicated to the issues that affect us all—issues like public safety, development, and the allocation of city resources?

Meetings have become less about open dialogue and more about procedural formalities. Key issues are rolled into the Consent Agenda, public discussion is limited, and we spend more time hearing about events that have already happened than discussing the future of our city.**

This pattern needs to change.

** As residents of College Park, we have a right to expect our elected officials to show up, to engage, and to address the issues that matter most to us. When meetings are moved arbitrarily and important decisions are made without proper discussion, it’s time to take a stand.

We encourage you to stay informed and continue to engage. Let’s hold our council accountable to the standards they promised us when they ran for office.

Sincerely,
**United College Park**

When you silence a council member, you silence the voice of everyone in that ward who voted for them. This particular meeting was where we chose our current City Manager. This isn’t just an issue of convenience; . If meetings are constantly shifted to fit the schedules of a select few, how can we trust that our voices are being heard and that decisions are being made with the full council present? | | | Let’s talk about how time is spent during these meetings. To put it bluntly, a lot of time is wasted. What should be a space for open discussion and decision-making is often reduced to a procedural exercise where most key decisions are bundled into a Consent Agenda. Instead of discussing and debating important issues publicly, they are approved en masse with little to no conversation. If you blink, you’ll miss it. And then there’s the , as well as, issues of Mayor and Council Reports. At the September 16th meeting, nearly 50 minutes —almost half of the meeting—were spent on the council patting themselves on the back. Shouldn’t more time be dedicated to the issues that affect us all—issues like public safety, development, and the allocation of city resources? Meetings have become less about open dialogue and more about procedural formalities. Key issues are rolled into the Consent Agenda, public discussion is limited, and we spend more time hearing about events that have already happened than discussing the future of our city. This pattern needs to change. As residents of College Park, we have a right to expect our elected officials to show up, to engage, and to address the issues that matter most to us. When meetings are moved arbitrarily and important decisions are made without proper discussion, it’s time to take a stand. We encourage you to stay informed and continue to engage. Let’s hold our council accountable to the standards they promised us when they ran for office. Sincerely, United College Park | | | | One more thing... | | | | | Since you're free on Monday... Join Mayor Bianca Motley Broom at the College Park Public Safety Complex (3717 College Street, College Park, GA 30337), this is your chance to hear key updates and engage in transparent communication. Mayor Motley Broom will openly share her insights and create space for you to voice your concerns, ask questions, and celebrate community victories. | | | | | | Before the town hall, join us at The Brake Pad for Drinks and Democracy where we discuss the opportunities for College Park's future and how we can actively be a part of it's betterment. MY LIFELONG COMMITMENT
I Need Your Help to Get Over the Finish Line
Dear Peter,
Environmental health and human health are inseparable. The toxic chemicals polluting our air, soil, and water also seep into our bodies and our children’s bodies. They damage our health the same way they destroy nature.
**That’s why good environmental policy is also good health policy.**
Just a few days ago, I stood in front of the Environmental Protection Agency in Washington, DC, reflecting on how the environment used to unite us. After all, every American loves nature and wants clean air, clean water, and a healthy future for our children.
I’ve spent my career as an attorney advocating for children’s health and the environment. When I’m in Washington in the Trump administration, I will continue both.
[We are going to **Make America Healthy Again**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-epa?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=epa_10_3_24_all_1&n=5) – and that includes our soil, our water, and our bodies.
**And let me tell you one other kind of pollution** I’m going to help get rid of. It is the pollution of our government agencies by corporate money. It’s called, corruption.
When Big Pharma money, Big Ag money, and Big Tech money pollutes Washington DC, it’s not long before their chemicals pollute the entire country.
**__That’s going to end when I’m in Washington.__**

clean_body: Here's what I'm going to clean up when I get to Washington. | | | | | | | MY LIFELONG COMMITMENT I Need Your Help to Get Over the Finish Line Dear Peter, Environmental health and human health are inseparable. The toxic chemicals polluting our air, soil, and water also seep into our bodies and our children’s bodies. They damage our health the same way they destroy nature. That’s why good environmental policy is also good health policy. Just a few days ago, I stood in front of the Environmental Protection Agency in Washington, DC, reflecting on how the environment used to unite us. After all, every American loves nature and wants clean air, clean water, and a healthy future for our children. I’ve spent my career as an attorney advocating for children’s health and the environment. When I’m in Washington in the Trump administration, I will continue both. – and that includes our soil, our water, and our bodies. And let me tell you one other kind of pollution I’m going to help get rid of. It is the pollution of our government agencies by corporate money. It’s called, corruption. When Big Pharma money, Big Ag money, and Big Tech money pollutes Washington DC, it’s not long before their chemicals pollute the entire country. That’s going to end when I’m in Washington. President Trump has given me his solid backing to help him clean the poisons out of our soil, our water, our bodies, and our political system. so I can keep up the pressure and bring my lifelong commitment to health and the environment to Washington. | | Robert F. I’m running for Congress to pick up where my mom and the trailblazers before us left off so we can build a government that truly reflects the great diversity and strength of our nation.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94217023/502876934/478451526?refcode=BLU_EM_GOOD_2024-10-03_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTMwMjAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDJkNThjMGUtZDU4MS1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=vsPnGChoOdju0by7F7e7kr-NFT3kJ60bYKEoMmpfOV4=)
---
Peter,

In 1988, my mom, Betty Tamposi, ran for this very same Congressional seat after serving our community in the New Hampshire legislature for 6 years. During that race, her opponent’s campaign used the phrase:
_**“A woman’s place is in the home, not in the House.”**_
My mom didn’t end up winning, but she _never_ backed down, and neither will I.

Today, women make up less than one-third of the members of Congress, but more and more women across the country are stepping up and running for office than ever before!

I’m running for Congress to pick up where my mom and the trailblazers before us left off so we can build a government that truly reflects the great diversity and strength of our nation. clean_body: I’m running for Congress to pick up where my mom and the trailblazers before us left off so we can build a government that truly reflects the great diversity and strength of our nation. | = Peter, In 1988, my mom, Betty Tamposi, ran for this very same Congressional seat after serving our community in the New Hampshire legislature for 6 years. During that race, her opponent’s campaign used the phrase: “A woman’s place is in the home, not in the House.” My mom didn’t end up winning, but she never backed down, and neither will I. Today, women make up less than one-third of the members of Congress, but more and more women across the country are stepping up and running for office than ever before! I’m running for Congress to pick up where my mom and the trailblazers before us left off so we can build a government that truly reflects the great diversity and strength of our nation. That means fighting to defend reproductive freedom, protect our sacred right to vote, and lower costs for hard-working families. It’s time for a new generation of women to flip the script and prove that a woman’s place is in the People’s House – but I can’t do that without your continued support. = | = | = | = | = | = With gratitude, Maggie Goodlander * | | = Paid for by Maggie for Congress Maggie for Congress 131 Daniel Webster Hwy #949 Nashua, NH 03060 United States | | | ---|---|--- = =

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2019%2E135344%2EoLcbtH)

Friend --
Donald Trump and Mike Rogers just got off the stage at a rally in Saginaw, wrapping up Trump’s 12th visit (!) to the state and 6th in as many weeks.
Here’s the big takeaway: Trump’s message is that 1,430 days since the 2020 election -- and just 33 days before the 2024 election -- he's still claiming he won the 2020 election. He went on about it in detail. He also attacked autoworkers, pledged to defund the Department of Education, and bragged about trying to cheat his employees out of their overtime pay.
The thing is, we’ve seen this movie before.
The reality is that if Trump loses Michigan, he will almost certainly lose the White House -- and Republicans will lose the Senate. And the better I do in my race, the better Kamala Harris likely does in the state as well.
That’s why Republicans are throwing everything they can at Michigan: Outside groups have already spent or committed more than $38 million in TV ads attacking me and propping up Mike Rogers -- and just this week, Mitch McConnell’s super PAC announced an additional $22.5 million against us.
The latest polls show our state is virtually tied -- for both the presidential and the Senate race. Political forecaster Nate Silver’s recently published analysis said not only that Michigan is a pure toss up, but also that there may be no state more important than Michigan in this election.
The only thing we know for certain is that this race will come down to the wire and could go either way on Election Day. And with voters in Michigan already casting their ballots, we can’t waste a single moment in this race. Every voter we reach, every door we knock, every ad we air, and yes every dollar we raise, can be the difference in a race like ours.
But we are not powerless in this campaign.

It’s Jon Cryer.
You may have grown up with me in _Pretty in Pink_ or laughed alongside (or at) me as I tried to raise half a man on _Two and a Half Men_.
I’ve loved playing so many different characters over the years and making families across America laugh, but today I’m writing to you because I am deeply concerned about the future of our country.
**If Donald Trump is back in the White House and Rick Scott is back in the Senate as GOP Leader, it will be disastrous for our families, our freedoms, and our democracy.[If you’re all in to hold the Senate majority and protect our freedoms with me, chip in to Debbie Mucarsel-Powell’s campaign now in these critical few weeks before Election Day >>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94217671/502879224/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2105-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWYzMWRlYmEtZDc4MS1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=BVeKgn8i-Ay9BsHweH74QZwr7lYqrNlJ-CMbulyoUD8=)**
Rick Scott is the biggest thief in the Senate — which is saying something for the half a man that he is. He oversaw the largest Medicare fraud scandal in U.S. history. He’s ready to push a nationwide ban on abortions and strip Americans of their right to access reproductive health care. He’s responsible for the insurance premium crisis that is forcing Floridians to choose between going uninsured or leaving the state altogether, and he wrote the plan to end Social Security and Medicare.
**Simply put, Rick Scott is only looking out for himself and his own political gain with his extremist policies. He’s a danger to all Americans. But luckily, I have hope in Debbie Mucarsel-Powell.**
Debbie’s been a fighter for Americans and our freedoms. As an associate dean at FIU’s medical school, she fought to bring health care to underserved communities. In her work with Giffords, she fought for commonsense gun safety laws to keep our communities safe. In Congress, she wrote the bill to expand Medicaid and secured $200 million for Everglades protections.
I know our future looks brighter with Debbie Mucarsel-Powell as Florida’s next Senator. But she needs our help to fight back against Rick Scott and his mega-millions. Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re reaching out today because we're just about a month away from the most competitive election of our lives in the two most competitive Senate campaigns in the country.

**Contact:** Griffin Reid, Communications Director, _**[greid@indiana.gop](mailto:greid@indiana.gop "greid@indiana.gop")**_

_**Statement on Mike Braun's Second Victory in Two Days**_ **INDIANAPOLIS, Ind. (October 3, 2024)** – Indiana Republican Party Chairman, Randy Head, issued the following statement on Senator Mike Braun's victory in the second gubernatorial debate.
---
_**Statement from Indiana GOP Chairman Randy Head:**_
---
"Mike Braun won tonight’s debate and proved he is the best candidate to lead Indiana. Mike is a serious leader who will make a difference in Hoosiers' pocketbooks and at their kitchen tables. Braun will attack inflation, lower the cost of healthcare, and fix problems with education spending. These are the kitchen table issues that matter to Hoosiers.

In contrast, Jennifer McCormick is out of step with everyday Hoosiers. She supported Biden and the irresponsible spending that caused inflation. She is in favor of adding another layer of government bureaucracy that will result in higher taxes. She can’t run away from her open endorsement of expensive, liberal policies that Hoosiers don’t want.

Mike Braun won both today's and yesterday's debates with his common sense plans to shrink inflation, reduce taxes, and keep more money in our pockets. This is the leader Hoosiers want.”
---

subject: Look who I ran into today!
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
It was bound to happen eventually. Today I had my first encounter with Jim Jordan.
It’s true – the man who’s been dodging real questions for 17 years decided to crawl out from his ULTRA-MAGA echo chamber and show up in the district.
Here’s what happened:
I arrived at the Delaware County Treasurer's summit today, and there he was—Mr. “I Don't Pass Bills” , standing in front of a crowd like he’s actually done something for us.
He was taking questions and as soon as he saw me, he panicked and tried to head for the door.
He said, “Well, I see my guy just stood up, so that’s my sign. I just took my last question and it’s time to go.”
I yelled, “I have a question! I have a question!”
The guy carrying the mic showed up out of nowhere and handed me the mic.
I smiled and said, “Oh, thank you.” I turned, looked at Jordan disgusted, and asked:
You always talk about high crime in Democrat-run cities, but where were you when Marion had their huge FBI drug bust?
Where were you when Richland County and Allen County had all those murders?
He said, “Yeah, crime has gone up.”
I said, “But where have you been when the district needed you?”
“Why haven’t you passed any bills?”
“Why haven’t you brought any money home to the district?”
“Why haven’t you brought any jobs to the district?”
And just like always, Jordan did what he does best—he mumbled something, pulled at his pants, and scurried away.
Jim Jordan has been in this seat for 17 YEARS and not passed a single bill. The fact is he doesn’t have any answers for OH-04 because he’s not interested in helping anyone in this district. Help me send him packing in just over a month. We’re close to hitting our $2 Million dollar goal, so please dig deep and rush $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can and let’s kick Jordan out of Congress for good . [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241003_confronting_jordan_link1]
I’m not afraid to say, I made him nervous today. He is not ready for anyone who truly challenges him, but you know me, I’m a fighter, and I’ll never back down.
Jordan SHOULD be nervous, because this is the first campaign to have him on the ropes. And with you by my side, we’re going to WIN this seat and elect a fighter for the people.
This is the most important congressional race in the country because we have the double opportunity to defeat the most dangerous man in Congress and help flip the House for Harris and Walz with a huge Democratic pick-up.
Once we do, we can focus on lowering the cost of living, protecting Social Security, expanding healthcare access, making prescription drugs affordable, and finally tackling climate change to build a safer, more sustainable future for all Americans.
Contribute today to help us make this vision a reality on November 5th. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241003_confronting_jordan_link2]
Let’s do this!
Working for US,

Electing Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. Protecting our Senate majority. Winning re-election. _It’s a tall order._ **All of this is going to require more resources than ever — this is going to be the most expensive election of our lifetimes!** While MAGA Republicans open up their rolodex of right-wing billionaires and call in favors for big campaign checks, my work has always been funded by grassroots donors like you. The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

subject: It’s Time for the Texas Legislature to Ban Taxpayer-Funded Lobbying
body:
Taxpayer-funded lobbying is undermining the voice of Texans in government and diluting one of their most precious rights—the right to petition the government for a redress of grievances.
No images? [Click here](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-e-syklutd-yuddtktydi-x/) [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-syklutd-yuddtktydi-r/) **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Press Manager
Contact: [Press@HuffinesLiberty.com](mailto:Press@HuffinesLiberty.com)
## **It 's Time for the Texas Legislature to Ban Taxpayer-Funded Lobbying**
[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-syklutd-yuddtktydi-y/) DALLAS, TX, October 3, 2024 -- Today, the Huffines Liberty Foundation is releasing our latest solutions paper, [_It 's Time for the Texas Legislature to Ban Taxpayer-Funded Lobbying_](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-syklutd-yuddtktydi-j/).Taxpayer-funded lobbying is undermining the voice of Texans in government and diluting one of their most precious rights--the right to petition the government for a redress of grievances. In 2021, local governments in Texas spent millions of dollars in taxpayer money to hire registered lobbyists, often to fight against the very people funding them. This practice is a direct threat to citizens' constitutional rights and must be stopped.**The Problem: Drowning Out Citizens ' Voices**
Texans' right to petition their government is enshrined in the First Amendment of the U.S. Constitution and dates back to the Magna Carta of 1215. Despite this, taxpayer-funded lobbying is increasingly silencing citizen voices in Austin.Local governments, backed by taxpayer dollars, are employing lobbyists to advocate against the interests of the very people they represent. In one instance from 2019, rural Texans testified against bills that would have expanded property tax abatements for politically connected businesses. Yet, for every citizen who showed up, there were multiple lobbyists representing local governments, businesses receiving the abatements, and their associated organizations, all working against the public's interest.Texans overwhelmingly petition their state officials to lower taxes and curb government spending. However, lobbyists hired by local governments are advocating for more spending and higher taxes, creating an unbalanced battle where citizens are often outnumbered and ignored.**The Scale of the Issue**
In 2021, local Texas governments spent $75 million on registered lobbyists, not including the salaries of in-house lobbyists or the funds funneled to pro-government associations such as the Texas Municipal League, the Texas Association of Counties, and the Texas Association of School Boards. The total cost of this taxpayer-funded lobbying is likely much higher.The Texas Public Policy Foundation reports that local government lobbying expenses have skyrocketed, nearly doubling from $41 million in 2017 to $75 million in 2021. This unchecked spending is not only wasteful but also corrosive to the democratic process.Taxpayer-funded lobbyists are not just hired to pass legislation; they are hired to kill citizen-priority legislation, stop investigations and audits into government practices, and block efforts to improve transparency.**Protecting Against Government Corruption**
One of the most dangerous aspects of taxpayer-funded lobbying is its use to shield government entities from accountability. Lobbyists paid with public funds are often deployed to block audits, investigations, and transparency measures that could expose waste, fraud, or corruption within government.This is not just about passing or defeating legislation--it's about protecting against government corruption. Public officials should not be using taxpayer dollars to prevent accountability or conceal misconduct. Yet, this is precisely what happens when taxpayer-funded lobbyists work to suppress audits or limit oversight. This practice undermines public trust and weakens the foundations of good governance.**The Solution: Ban Taxpayer-Funded Lobbying**
To restore Texans' right to petition their government without interference, the Texas Legislature must take decisive action. Here are key steps that must be implemented:
1. **_Ban Lobbying with Public Funds:_** Local governments should be prohibited from using taxpayer money to employ or contract with registered lobbyists. Public funds should not be used to pay for any lobbying expenses.
2. **_Prohibit Membership Dues to Lobbyist Organizations:_** Government agencies, cities, counties, and school boards should be barred from using taxpayer money to pay membership dues to any organization that employs or contracts with registered lobbyists, such as the Texas Municipal League or Texas Association of School Boards.
3. **_Stop Influence on Legislative Measures:_****__** Political subdivisions must be prevented from using public money to influence the passage or defeat of any legislative measure.
4. **_Ban Lobbying by Businesses Receiving Tax Abatements:_****__** Any business receiving property tax abatements from local governments should be prohibited from employing or contracting with registered lobbyists. These businesses should not be able to lobby for more taxpayer-funded perks.

**Conclusion**
Taxpayer-funded lobbying is an abuse of public trust. The voices of Texans are being drowned out by well-funded lobbyists hired with their own tax dollars. Worse, taxpayer-funded lobbyists are being used to block government transparency, shield corruption, and oppose the interests of those they claim to represent.The Texas Legislature must act to restore the balance of power and protect the citizens' right to petition their government without interference from local governments and special interests. By implementing these reforms, we can ensure that the interests of Texans--not lobbyists--are heard in Austin. Our mission is to advance the cause of **liberty** , **prosperity** , and **virtue** in the State of Texas by educating and equipping citizens so they may hold their elected officials accountable and better informed to tackle the toughest challenges.### [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-syklutd-yuddtktydi-u/)[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-syklutd-yuddtktydi-o/)[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-syklutd-yuddtktydi-b/) | [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-syklutd-yuddtktydi-n/) | [ Share ](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-fb-syklutd-yuddtktydi-c/) | [ Tweet ](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-tw-syklutd-yuddtktydi-v/) | [ Forward ](https://huffineslibertyfoundation.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-yuddtktydi-17329976-syklutd-l-e)

Fellow patriot,

During the VP Debate, we once again watched liberal politicians and the mainstream media lie about the illegal Haitian immigrants who are creating havoc in the town of Springfield, Ohio.

And when JD Vance tried to call them out on their lies and share the facts, **they muted him.**

_They’re trying to do the same thing to me_ -- they’re suing me, along with JD, Pres. Trump, Elon Musk, and others over speaking out about this disaster.

JD didn’t let left-wing censorship stop him from continuing to stand up for the truth and the citizens of Ohio, **and neither will I.**
