body:
#

Peter — I’m a little confused.
On September 30th this team came together and helped us put up an incredible day of fundraising. One of the best of the campaign.
It was awesome. It put some wind in my sails, honestly. Gave me hope.
But... yesterday we had one of the worst fundraising days in months. No joke. People just aren’t chipping in, and that is a huge problem.
My team’s getting really worried. I’ve told them to take it day by day, but I promised I’d reach out and ask you — what happened, Peter?
Do people really think this race is all wrapped up? Cause I can tell you, personally, that it’s not. This state is going to be decided by less votes than it takes to fill a football stadium, and that is the truth. Arizona isn’t a blue state. Until very recently it was one of the reddest states in the country, and it could very easily go that way again.
But right now, we’re not pacing to our goals. We’re not pacing to stop Trump and Kari Lake from winning this November. And if we don’t pick things back up — FAST — we’re going to be in real trouble.

body:
| | | [ ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3e99e18aff&e=a7ab36849c)

| | Good evening, Freedom Fighters,

First off, please don’t forget to RSVP for our Meet and Greet tomorrow from 4:30pm to 6pm with other local Republican candidates in north Phoenix. _If you’re available and haven't already RSVPd, you can do so by replying to this email and we will share the address with you._

District 2 voters have been very receptive at the doors as we approach 32 more days until the November election. Over the past few weeks, the district’s true swing voters have told us while campaigning they are getting inundated with text messages, direct mail, emails, canvassers at their doorsteps, and ads on the TV. I have reiterated the need for early voters to mail back their ballots so we can continue to shift our get out the vote efforts and resources. The silver lining of voting early by mail: the text messages and direct mail will stop for those voters who already voted as campaigns with lean budgets remove those voters from their target lists.

Sadly, Arizona is a battleground state. The legislature under Governor Ducey welcomed new businesses to the state due to our pro-business climate and low taxes and low regulatory burdens. Thus, we are still seeing 200+ people moving to the Valley each day. Arizona has consistently been in the top 10 for incoming population growth for the past few years. We all see California drivers on our roadways each day and probably groan. Anyone looking to buy or sell their home over the past few years can attest our housing prices are not as affordable as they had once been. District 2 is also home to quite a bit of apartment and condo complexes, motor home parks and manufactured home communities. Not everyone owns a home in our district. In 2022, I championed a bill to get rid of the residential rental tax.

Along the campaign trail, the threat of a potential Northeast and Gulf Coast port strike had been beginning to creep into the minds of our local voters and how it might impact who they vote for come November. Like the panic shopping witnessed during covid, consumers were already heading to the store to stock up on bottled water and toilet paper even though stakeholders representing grocery stores and retailers said these items will not be impacted by the strike. I have seen local consumers posting pictures the past two days from their local membership warehouses and grocery stores with empty shelves. Thankfully, it sounds like the port workers have a tentative deal to alleviate further disruptions of our supply chain. Wholesalers had already gone on record to let consumers know they were working on finding efficient alternatives to minimize disruptions to consumers before a deal was struck.

These pocketbook issues will likely remain on the top of the minds of voters as we head into November. Constituents’ grocery bills are already higher than the pre-covid era. Inflation, high fuel and food prices have been a few of the top issues voters bring up when we chat with them at the door. In 2019, I championed a bill to eliminate the tax on groceries. As the Chairman of the House Committee on Ways and Means in 2021 and 2022, I killed every bill that would have increased the tax on gas, keeping more money in your pocketbook.

During the interim, I am still balancing meetings at the Capitol and completing some official duties of this office. For instance, a few weeks ago, I had the honor of attending the graduation ceremony of six new Phoenix Police Department Reserves. To learn more about the program and the requirements, please visit their [website](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=90f2264752&e=a7ab36849c) for additional information on how to apply to become a Reserve Police Officer.

Last week, I hosted a group of pastors visiting from Russia and Ukraine. Their churches were closed, and these pastors and their congregants faced physical violence, threats and loss of their right to openly practice their Christian faith. At one point, 119 of his pastors at a retreat were forced to lay down on the ground by military troops, threatened with death and several were beaten. Many lost their livelihoods and material possessions as well. I am a firm believer and supporter of religious freedom. We need to keep the United States on this path. I traveled to China with my family in 2018. China is known worldwide for violating individual’s right to freedom of religion by persecuting individuals, imprisoning them, and inflicting physical abuse on certain religions.

Last Friday I stopped by Quail Run Behavioral Health for a brief tour of their hospital and to learn more about how they are working with adolescents and seniors in our community. Their CEO, Chris Ruble, met me at the entrance and helped me along on the tour. For nearly two weeks, I have been hopping along in a walking boot since I twisted and sprained my ankle and ligaments along the campaign trail. Once the November election is behind us, hopefully, my right foot can heal properly.

Last week we also had a successful fundraiser with Governor Doug Ducey and Karrin Robson Taylor. If you attended or donated to this event, thank you so much! One of the individuals who came out to support my candidacy is David Graybill. David is a local philanthropist and entrepreneur who has invested his time and talent into ending human trafficking with the [GOTCHA Project.](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6d973eaa52&e=a7ab36849c) GOTCHA means: Get Off the Couch & Heal America. The goal of GOTCHA is to have Americans more aware and involved in the needs of the people in their own community, city, state, and country. His patriotic fire trucks celebrate the U.S. Constitution and our God-given freedoms. David has also launched a new project called “Pink Heals.” Pink Heals was founded on the premise that it is the heart of the woman that holds our families, communities and a country together.

On October 10th, we have another campaign fundraiser in downtown Phoenix from 4:30pm to 6pm. _Please reply to this email with your RSVP and we will share the location of the event with you._

We are also working on a final fundraiser for 2024 targeting mid to late October with some amazing supporters in District 2 along with Congressman John Shadegg in the Moon Valley area. Stay tuned for further details.

Each day I have the pleasure of meeting so many longtime and new supporters of mine. clean_body: | | | | | Good evening, Freedom Fighters, First off, please don’t forget to RSVP for our Meet and Greet tomorrow from 4:30pm to 6pm with other local Republican candidates in north Phoenix. If you’re available and haven't already RSVPd, you can do so by replying to this email and we will share the address with you. District 2 voters have been very receptive at the doors as we approach 32 more days until the November election. Over the past few weeks, the district’s true swing voters have told us while campaigning they are getting inundated with text messages, direct mail, emails, canvassers at their doorsteps, and ads on the TV. I have reiterated the need for early voters to mail back their ballots so we can continue to shift our get out the vote efforts and resources. The silver lining of voting early by mail: the text messages and direct mail will stop for those voters who already voted as campaigns with lean budgets remove those voters from their target lists. Sadly, Arizona is a battleground state. The legislature under Governor Ducey welcomed new businesses to the state due to our pro-business climate and low taxes and low regulatory burdens. Thus, we are still seeing 200+ people moving to the Valley each day. Arizona has consistently been in the top 10 for incoming population growth for the past few years. We all see California drivers on our roadways each day and probably groan. Anyone looking to buy or sell their home over the past few years can attest our housing prices are not as affordable as they had once been. District 2 is also home to quite a bit of apartment and condo complexes, motor home parks and manufactured home communities. Not everyone owns a home in our district. In 2022, I championed a bill to get rid of the residential rental tax. Along the campaign trail, the threat of a potential Northeast and Gulf Coast port strike had been beginning to creep into the minds of our local voters and how it might impact who they vote for come November. Like the panic shopping witnessed during covid, consumers were already heading to the store to stock up on bottled water and toilet paper even though stakeholders representing grocery stores and retailers said these items will not be impacted by the strike. I have seen local consumers posting pictures the past two days from their local membership warehouses and grocery stores with empty shelves. Thankfully, it sounds like the port workers have a tentative deal to alleviate further disruptions of our supply chain. Wholesalers had already gone on record to let consumers know they were working on finding efficient alternatives to minimize disruptions to consumers before a deal was struck. name: Derrick Gates Ministries
subject: Derrick Gates Los Angeles Mission
body:
###**Los Angeles Mission Update**

**Dear Friends, Family, and Partners,**

As we press into the heart of this pivotal prophetic hour, we find ourselves living in a time of unparalleled opportunity to see God’s Kingdom established on the earth. The Lord is inviting each of us into a deeper alignment with His purposes, where our obedience can shift nations and ignite a generation. Here in the mission field of Los Angeles, we believe this is the moment to build, expand, and press in with fervor—to see revival fire touch every heart and every home.

The global church stands at a crucial crossroads, with the return of Jesus nearer than ever. In this hour, He is calling His bride to be a people marked by integrity, fervor, prayer, and fasting—a people of radical devotion and unwavering commitment to His Kingdom. The need for bold, courageous lions has never been more urgent. We are contending for the fullness of what God has promised in this generation: the outpouring of the Spirit, salvation for the lost, and the power of His Kingdom manifesting on earth. Our focus is clear: Kingdom-building and disciple-making. This is what we are pursuing with all our hearts.

**The Call to Los Angeles**
===========================

Right now, we are expanding our ministry to equip, train, and send laborers into every sphere of influence. We have witnessed incredible fruit in the entertainment, media, government, and faith sectors. Now, we are believing for swift manifestation in the marketplace. But to meet the growing demand for training and outreach, we need partners like never before. Immediate needs include:

**- Upgrading our music equipment with a mobile system, readily available for any gathering.**

**- Resourcing monthly outreach events to minister to the homeless and those living in government housing.**

**- Securing two passenger vans for fellowship transport and to assist people with appointments.**

**- Establishing program houses to transition people off the streets and out of prisons, helping them become Jesus-following, Kingdom-minded citizens. In Kansas City, we had up to six homes serving this purpose, and we are believing for the same here.**

God has also given us a vision for greater financial stability. As many of you know, Los Angeles is one of the most expensive cities in the world. This has been a significant burden on our family, but we have carried it joyfully for the sake of the Kingdom. We believe the Lord has shown us several avenues for financial independence, but it will take time and resources to bring this to fruition. Scripture speaks of God giving us "witty inventions" to sustain us, and we are believing for this divine provision. As ***Proverbs 8:12 says, "I, wisdom, dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions."*** We trust that God’s heart is for us to be free from the strain of financial lack.

###How You Can Partner

This is where your partnership becomes essential. We are praying for those who will come alongside us financially in this season of Kingdom expansion. Your giving is more than support for a ministry; it is a seed sown into the eternal purposes of God. Every dollar, every seed, is a direct investment in the move of God in our day.

We are believing for $8,000 a month in partnership over the next three years. This will help alleviate the immediate financial burden of meeting spaces and outreach costs, while fueling our expansion to mobilize intercessors, missionaries, and leaders for the Great Harvest. **We also know that anything helps, and even $20 from our supporters will add up**. Here’s how you can partner with us:

1.******One-Time Gift** – A strategic donation will help us acquire a mobile PA system, expand our outreach efforts, and upgrade essential resources.

2. **Monthly Partnership** – By committing to give monthly, you will sustain the ongoing work that fuels revival here and beyond.

3. **Outreach Vehicle Donation** – Perhaps you have a vehicle you would like to donate to support our West Coast mission.

Beloved, this is your invitation to engage with what God is doing in this critical hour. Together, we can leave a lasting Kingdom impact—bringing heaven to earth, making disciples, and training leaders. Would you prayerfully consider sowing into this vision?

As you give, we stand with you in faith, believing for an abundant harvest in every area of your life. You are part of the story God is writing for this generation, and we are deeply grateful for your partnership in this holy endeavor.

Thank you for your prayers, your generosity, and your faithfulness to the Lord’s calling. Together, we will see His glory cover the earth as the waters cover the sea.

In His Grip,
Derrick & Nena Gates

**To sow**

[**Paypal.me/derrickgates**](https://ej5iv.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/6rqJfgq8dINmNjc0lA8lNItwKgS/BKeP3DGhtIEF)

Venmo @Derrick-Gates-4

Cash App $derrickgatesmin

Zelle=816-433-2072 nena gates

Update on Ministry Areas
========================

**Family:**

Beloved, our family is thriving in ways that only the grace of God could empower. As many of you know, Nena and I have been walking with great intentionality on our health journey. I’ve lost 135 pounds in the past year, and Nena has shed 125 pounds. We both underwent stem cell therapy, and it’s not an exaggeration to say that it has completely transformed our lives. You can read more about that testimony below, but let me tell you, it’s a testament to the mercy and power of God.

Derrick Jr. is also taking his health seriously, and has lost over 20 pounds in just the past couple of months. His MMA training is advancing, and he's likely the strongest on his team. Recently, he faced an experienced 26-year-old man, and at just 16, Derrick Jr. won every submission match! But the greater victory is his heart. He recently had an encounter with God that has set his heart on fire. Now, he’s in the Word and journaling regularly. *This is the fruit of prayer, saints.*

Jessie is still leading worship at our church plant, and she and Neil are approaching their one-year anniversary. God is knitting their hearts together in such beauty, and we’re excited to see what’s in store for them.

**Ministry:**

Where do I even begin? There’s so much happening that my heart can hardly contain it all. Recently, our spiritual mom, Patricia King, ministered at our church, and *oh*, it was glorious. The presence of God was so thick, and lives were changed in His glory. This month, on the 13th, I have the privilege of ministering at her church in Maricopa, Arizona. Outside of our California work, I’m limiting my travels to one week a month, as we feel a deep calling to steward the local flame God has entrusted to us. If you'd like me to minister in your area, I’d love to connect and get something on the calendar. There's no limit to what God is doing, and we want to partner with you in faith!

**Government:**

God is opening doors of influence. As you may know, I was elected to a key position during the March primary election—one that allows me to act as a gatekeeper against RINOs seeking office. I’m honored to also serve as Vice President of the California Republican Assembly while fulfilling my role as Chaplain and Faith Outreach Coordinator. There is yet another internal election coming up in December, and many have rallied behind me for this position. I’m not revealing the details yet, but please continue to keep me in prayer as God unfolds His plans. *This is Kingdom influence in government, saints!*

**Media: **

We’re on the brink of something powerful with our podcast. The new studio is ready, and next week we’ll begin bringing in guests regularly. We will be on all the major streaming platforms, lifting up the name of Jesus in the media. Stay tuned, because God is going to move mightily through this platform.

**Entertainment: **

God is making divine connections. I’ve built strong relationships with Hollywood actors and other influencers, and we’re in pre-production for a documentary on Christians in Hollywood. Imagine that—a light shining in the heart of the entertainment world! Additionally, we’re planning a Christian film festival for 2025, where we will celebrate Kingdom creativity. *The arts are being redeemed for His glory!*

We are so deeply grateful for your prayers and partnership in these many areas of ministry and life. We feel the covering of your intercession, and we know that God is just getting started. Thank you for standing with us as we run this race together.

To sow

[**Paypal.me/derrickgates**](https://ej5iv.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/6rqJfgq8dIPRQBuAFTYJIu1rxzU/XGpQL29xnbDA)

Venmo @Derrick-Gates-4

Cash App $derrickgatesmin

Zelle=816-433-2072 nena gates

**Our Health Journey**

We stand in awe of what’s unfolding right before our eyes! Many of you have already heard about Nena’s miraculous health transformation, but let me remind you just how extraordinary it truly is. From being given just six months to live, facing stage 5 cancer, to now being on the brink of hearing the final confirmation that she is completely cancer-free, we’ve witnessed the impossible become reality. Her body has come alive again—wrinkles gone, hair regrown to its original color, vision restored to 20/20, energy levels skyrocketing, and her insulin intake dropping drastically. And to top it off, she’s lost 100 pounds! This is not just a health story—it’s a testimony to the relentless power of faith and cutting-edge therapy.

But that’s not all. Three months ago, I also decided to take the plunge into this life-changing therapy. Chronic pain once crippled me, and I had to rely on a cane and heavy medication just to make it through the day. I was even declared permanently disabled. But God had other plans. Just four days after my treatment, my knee pain vanished. Gone. Completely! I’ve spent hours on my knees recently—something I couldn’t even imagine before. My energy has surged, my mind has sharpened, my skin has cleared, and weight loss has become a reality—130 pounds gone since last year! But the most astonishing part? I’ve regained 25% movement in my face after being paralyzed due to a vaccine injury.

We are not just healed but living proof that God is moving through this therapy. And now, we want to share this life-changing opportunity with you. This is not a sales pitch or some get-rich-quick scheme—this is a real, God-given solution that is changing lives, and it’s time for YOU to experience it for yourself!

This is YOUR invitation! We’re hosting an online Zoom session where you’ll hear all about this powerful therapy. Email me at **officialderrickgates@gmail.com** with "THERAPY" in the subject line, and I’ll get you registered. Don’t wait. Your life could be on the verge of a breakthrough, just like ours. And if you know someone else who could benefit, forward this invitation to them—let’s spread hope and healing!

This is your moment. Don’t miss it!

With overflowing gratitude and excitement,

**Derrick & Nena**

To me, family values mean, first and foremost, recognizing that families come in all shapes and sizes. And no matter what they look like, every family deserves to thrive.

That’s why I’m committed to fighting for:

**🍲 ****Families being able to put food on the table** – No one should worry about their next meal. We must continue our fight for economic policies that support working families and ensure no one goes hungry.

**🩺 ****Families affording their medications** – Healthcare is a right, not a privilege. We need to bring down the cost of prescription drugs and make sure every family has access to the care they need.

**🏡****Families living in affordable homes** – Everyone deserves a safe and stable place to live. It’s time we invest in affordable housing and support policies that help families thrive.

**🧡****Families living safely from gun violence** – Every family deserves to feel safe in their community, free from the threat of gun violence. We must pass common-sense gun safety laws to protect our children and our neighborhoods.
